words.en: If something is disappointing, it is not as good as you hoped it would be.

words.ex: The Nile River forms a large delta before it flows into the sea.
words.ex_cn: 尼罗河在流入大海之前形成了一个巨大的三角洲。
words.en: A delta is an area of low, flat land shaped like a triangle, where a river splits and spreads out into several branches before entering the sea.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.tr:
v. 称赞；恭维
n. 称赞；恭维
words.ex: He gave her a compliment on her dress.
words.ex_cn: 他夸了她的裙子。
words.en: A compliment is a polite expression of praise or admiration.

words.ex: The execution of the criminal was carried out last night.
words.ex_cn: 这名罪犯的处决昨晚执行了。
words.en: The carrying out or performance of a task, plan, or order.

words.ex: He inherited his family's heritage.
words.ex_cn: 他继承了家族的遗产。
words.en: Heritage refers to the traditions, achievements, beliefs, etc., that are part of the history of a group or nation.

words.tr: adj. 适当的；合适的；恰当的；
words.ex: This dress is appropriate for a wedding.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子适合参加婚礼。
words.en: Something that is appropriate is suitable or acceptable for a particular situation.

words.tr: adj. 一年一次的；每年的；
words.ex: The school holds an annual sports day.
words.ex_cn: 学校每年举行一次运动会。
words.en: An annual event happens once every year.

words.ex: The painting depicts a quiet village at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画描绘了一个宁静的村庄在日落时分的景象。
words.en: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

words.ex: Children need literacy to read books and write letters.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们需要有读写能力才能读书和写信。
words.en: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

words.ex: He calculates the total cost quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他快速计算出总成本。
words.en: To determine by mathematical methods; compute.

words.tr: n. 奢华；奢侈品；难得的享受；
words.ex: She bought a luxury dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她为派对买了一件奢华的裙子。
words.en: Luxury is very great comfort, especially among beautiful and expensive surroundings.

words.ex: I bought a souvenir from the beach.
words.ex_cn: 我从海边买了一个纪念品。
words.en: A souvenir is something which you buy or keep to remind you of a holiday, place, or event.

words.tr:
n. 购买；采购；
v. 购买；采购；
words.ex: The purchase of a new car took all his savings.
words.ex_cn: 买一辆新车花光了他所有的积蓄。
words.en: To purchase something means to buy it. It can also refer to something that has been bought.

words.tr: adj. 恒定的；不变的；持续的；
words.ex: The temperature is constant in this room.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间的温度是恒定的。
words.en: Something that is constant happens all the time or is always there.

words.ex: The plant is in dormancy during winter.
words.ex_cn: 这株植物在冬天处于休眠状态。
words.en: A state of rest or inactivity, often associated with a period of suspended development or growth.

words.tr:
adj. 特指的；特殊的；挑剔的；
n. 细节；详情；
words.ex: He wants a particular book, not any other.
words.ex_cn: 他想要一本特指的书，不是别的。
words.en: You use particular to emphasize that you are talking about one thing or one kind of thing rather than other similar ones.

words.ex: He pays a monthly subscription for the magazine.
words.ex_cn: 他每月支付杂志的订阅费。
words.en: A subscription is an amount of money that you pay regularly to receive a service or magazine, or to belong to or support an organization.

words.tr:
n. 音高；球场；程度（最高点）；宣传论点；
v. 扎营；
words.ex: The singer changed the pitch of her voice.
words.ex_cn: 歌手改变了她声音的音高。
words.en: Pitch can refer to the highness or lowness of a sound, the act of throwing something, or a thick, black, sticky substance used for paving roads or waterproofing.

words.tr: v. 授权；命名；给...权利（或资格）
words.ex: This book entitles you to a free gift.
words.ex_cn: 这本书使你有资格获得一份免费礼物。
words.en: If you are entitled to something, you have the right to have it or do it.

words.ex: He pressed the shutter to take a photo.
words.ex_cn: 他按下快门拍了一张照片。
words.en: A shutter is a device used to cover or uncover a window or a camera lens.

words.ex: They will demolish the old building next week.
words.ex_cn: 他们下周会拆掉那座旧建筑。
words.en: To demolish something such as a building means to destroy it completely. It can also mean to defeat someone completely in a discussion, argument, or competition.

words.ex: This bag is durable and lasts for years.
words.ex_cn: 这个包很耐用，可以用很多年。
words.en: Something that is durable is strong and lasts a long time without breaking or becoming weaker.

words.ex: He copes with stress by walking every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天散步来应对压力。
words.en: To cope with a problem or task means to deal with it successfully.

words.ex: The circulation of blood keeps us alive.
words.ex_cn: 血液的循环让我们活着。
words.en: The movement of something such as money or goods from place to place or from person to person; the number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are sold.

words.ex: My family follows the tradition of eating dumplings on New Year's Eve.
words.ex_cn: 我的家庭遵循除夕吃饺子的传统。
words.en: A tradition is a custom or belief that has existed for a long time among a particular group of people.

words.tr:
v. 有益于；有助于；
n. 利益；好处；
words.ex: Exercise benefits your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼有益于你的健康。
words.en: A benefit is something that helps you or improves your life in some way.

words.tr:
n. 腐烂；衰落；
v. 腐烂；
words.ex: The fruit began to show signs of decay.
words.ex_cn: 这水果开始出现腐烂的迹象。
words.en: To decay means to be slowly destroyed by a natural process or to become gradually worse in quality, condition, or strength.

words.ex: The distribution of students in the class is even.
words.ex_cn: 班级里学生的分布是均匀的。
words.en: The process of giving out or spreading something, or the way in which something is spread or arranged over an area or among a group of people.

words.ex: The defect in the phone made it hard to use.
words.ex_cn: 手机的缺陷让它很难使用。
words.en: A defect is a fault or imperfection in a person or thing.

words.ex: He opposes the new law.
words.ex_cn: 他反对这项新法律。
words.en: If you oppose someone or something, you disagree with them and try to prevent them from doing something, or you try to change what they are doing.

words.ex: The statistics show a rise in sales last year.
words.ex_cn: 这些统计数字显示去年销售额有所上升。
words.en: Statistics is a branch of mathematics dealing with the collection, analysis, interpretation, presentation, and organization of data.

words.ex: The room was stuffy and hard to breathe in.
words.ex_cn: 房间闷热得让人难以呼吸。
words.en: If you describe a place as stuffy, you mean that it is unpleasantly warm and has no fresh air.

words.ex: The trip takes approximately 30 minutes.
words.ex_cn: 这段旅程大约需要30分钟。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is close to the actual, but not completely accurate or exact.

words.tr: adj. 可原谅的；情有可原的；
words.ex: His excuse was excusable because he was sick.
words.ex_cn: 他的借口是可以原谅的，因为他生病了。
words.en: If something is excusable, it can be forgiven or understood because there is a good reason for it.

words.ex: He propose to go to the park after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他提议午饭后去公园。
words.en: If you propose something, you suggest it as a plan or course of action.

words.ex: The tree has many colorful ornaments.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树上有许多彩色的装饰品。
words.en: An ornament is an object that is used to make something look more attractive but is usually considered to have no practical purpose.

words.tr: adj. 有活力的；精力旺盛的；
words.ex: The energetic boy ran around the park all afternoon.
words.ex_cn: 这个有活力的男孩整个下午都在公园里跑来跑去。
words.en: Someone who is energetic is very active and does not tire easily.

words.ex: The atmospheric pressure dropped before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，大气压下降了。
words.en: Relating to the atmosphere of the Earth or another planet; creating a distinctive mood, typically of romance or nostalgia.

words.tr:
adj. 合作的；
n. 合作社；
words.ex: The two companies made a cooperative effort to solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 两家公司合作努力解决问题。
words.en: A cooperative is an organization or business that is owned and run jointly by its members, who share the profits or benefits.

words.ex: The iron fence will corrode in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 铁栅栏在雨中会生锈。
words.en: If metal or stone corrodes, or if something corrodes it, it is gradually destroyed by a chemical reaction.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；
v. 尊敬；
words.ex: He received an honour for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因英勇的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honour is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. It is a measure of a person's reputation and the esteem in which they are held by others.

words.tr:
prep. 除了；
conj. 只是；
words.ex: Everyone went to the party except Tom.
words.ex_cn: 除了汤姆，大家都去参加派对了。
words.en: You use except to introduce the only thing or person that a statement does not apply to, or a fact that prevents a statement from being completely true.

words.ex: Salt is soluble in water.
words.ex_cn: 盐可以溶于水。
words.en: A substance that is soluble can be dissolved in a liquid.

words.ex: The administration of the school is very organized.
words.ex_cn: 学校的行政管理非常有条理。
words.en: The process or activity of running a business, organization, etc., or the people who run it.

words.ex: He protects the environment by recycling.
words.ex_cn: 他通过回收利用来保护环境。
words.en: The environment is the natural world in which people, animals, and plants live.

words.ex: He got a driver's license last week.
words.ex_cn: 他上周拿到了驾照。
words.en: A license is an official document which gives you permission to do, use, or own something.

words.ex: The teacher underlined the key point.
words.ex_cn: 老师强调了这个关键点。
words.en: To draw a line under a word or phrase, especially in order to emphasize it.

words.tr: v. 激活；使活动；使活化；
words.ex: Press the button to activate the device.
words.ex_cn: 按下按钮来激活设备。
words.en: If a device or process is activated, it starts working or becomes operational.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；
n. 大调；主修课；
words.ex: Math is a major subject in school.
words.ex_cn: 数学是学校里的主要科目。
words.en: A major is a student's principal field of study or specialization in college or university.

words.tr: adj. 特定的；明确的；具体的；
words.ex: He gave a specific reason for being late.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个迟到的具体原因。
words.en: If someone is specific, they give a description that is precise and exact.

words.tr:
adj. 客观的；
n. 目标；目的；
words.ex: He gave an objective opinion about the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他对这部电影给出了一个客观的看法。
words.en: An objective is something that you plan to do or achieve.

words.ex: You must concentrate on your homework.
words.ex_cn: 你必须集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you concentrate on something, you give it your full attention and think about it carefully.

words.ex: The conflict between the two countries lasted for years.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家之间的冲突持续了多年。
words.en: A conflict is a serious disagreement or argument, typically a protracted one.

words.ex: The doctor gave him an antidote for the poison.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了他一种解毒剂来对抗毒药。
words.en: An antidote is a substance that counteracts the effects of poison or something harmful.

words.ex: He discovered a new planet last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年发现了一颗新行星。
words.en: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or find it.

words.ex: He doesn't necessarily agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 他并不必然同意你。
words.en: If you say that something necessarily happens or is the case, you mean that it has to happen or be the case and cannot be any different.

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: The castle has a small turret on each corner.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡的每个角落都有一个小塔。
words.en: A turret is a small tower on top of a building, especially a castle, or a structure on a military vehicle that can turn around and from which guns are fired.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.ex: Exercise can enhance your health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以提高你的健康。
words.en: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

words.ex: The teacher gave a demonstration of how to solve the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。
words.en: A demonstration is a public meeting or march in which people show their opposition to something or their support for something.

words.ex: He interrupted me while I was speaking.
words.ex_cn: 我在说话时他打断了我。
words.en: To interrupt someone means to stop them from speaking by saying or doing something, or to cause something to stop happening for a period of time.

words.ex: The extra chair is redundant because we have enough seats.
words.ex_cn: 这把额外的椅子是多余的，因为我们已经有足够的座位了。
words.en: If you are made redundant, your employer tells you to leave because your job is no longer necessary or because there is no more work for you.

words.tr: v. 处理不当；使用不当
words.ex: He mishandled the situation and made it worse.
words.ex_cn: 他处理不当，让情况变得更糟。
words.en: If you mishandle something, you deal with it badly or carelessly, often causing problems or damage.

words.ex: The discovery of penicillin saved millions of lives.
words.ex_cn: 青霉素的发现拯救了数百万人的生命。
words.en: The act of finding something that had not been known before.

words.tr: n. 含酒精的饮料；酒精；
words.ex: He drank alcohol at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上喝了含酒精的饮料。
words.en: Alcohol is a colourless liquid that can make you drunk, and which is used in medicines, cleaning products, and other substances.

words.ex: The government tried suppression of the protest.
words.ex_cn: 政府试图压制抗议。
words.en: The act of ending something by force or preventing it from being expressed or continuing.

words.ex: He mainly eats vegetables and fruit.
words.ex_cn: 他主要吃蔬菜和水果。
words.en: You use mainly to indicate that a statement is true in most cases or to a large extent.

words.ex: He lost all his property in the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他在火灾中失去了所有财产。
words.en: Something owned; a possession.

words.ex: The child was naked in the bathtub.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在浴缸里是裸体的。
words.en: If something is naked, it is not covered by anything such as clothes or paint.

words.tr:
n. 特征；报刊特写；
v. 以…为特色；是…的重要组成；
words.ex: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的主要特征是续航时间长。
words.en: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

words.ex: The camera has a clear lens.
words.ex_cn: 这台相机有一个清晰的透镜。
words.en: A lens is a piece of curved glass or other transparent substance that is used in things such as cameras, telescopes, or pairs of glasses to make images larger or smaller.

words.ex: She is the coordinator of the school event.
words.ex_cn: 她是学校活动的协调者。
words.en: A coordinator is someone whose job is to organize the various parts of an activity or the people involved in it so that it works efficiently.

words.ex: Mother's milk nourishes the baby.
words.ex_cn: 母乳滋养婴儿。
words.en: To nourish someone or something means to provide them with the food and other substances they need in order to live, grow, and be healthy.

words.ex: She ate a crisp apple for snack.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一个脆苹果当点心。
words.en: Something that is crisp is hard, and makes a pleasant sound when you break it or crush it.

words.ex: He felt guilty for lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对朋友撒谎而感到有罪。
words.en: If you feel guilty, you feel unhappy because you believe that you have done something wrong or have failed to do something which you should have done.

words.tr:
n. 裂缝；噼啪声；
v. 破裂；
words.ex: There is a small crack in the wall.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一条小裂缝。
words.en: If something hard cracks, or if you crack it, it becomes slightly damaged, with lines appearing on its surface.

words.tr: v. 繁荣兴旺；茁壮成长；
words.ex: The business flourishes in the new market.
words.ex_cn: 这家企业在新市场中繁荣兴旺。
words.en: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

words.tr:
n. 保护区；储备；保留；
v. 预订；
words.ex: The wildlife reserve is home to many endangered animals.
words.ex_cn: 这个自然保护区是许多濒危动物的家园。
words.en: If you reserve something such as a table, ticket, or magazine, you arrange for it to be kept for you and not given to anyone else.

words.tr: adj. 维度的；空间的；尺寸的
words.ex: The box has three dimensional shapes.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子有三个维度的形状。
words.en: Relating to measurements in length, width, and height, or to the spatial extent of something.

words.ex: The children played on the gravel path.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在砾石小路上玩耍。
words.en: Gravel consists of very small stones. It is often used to make paths and roads.

words.ex: He saw an advertisement on TV.
words.ex_cn: 他在电视上看到一则广告。
words.en: An advertisement is a notice or announcement in a public medium promoting a product, service, or event or publicizing a job vacancy.

words.ex: The house has good insulation to keep warm in winter.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有良好的绝缘层以在冬天保暖。
words.en: Insulation is a material or substance that is used to stop heat, electricity, or sound from going from one place to another.

words.ex: He spoke without hesitation.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不犹豫地说了。
words.en: Hesitation is the act of pausing before doing something, especially because you are nervous or not certain about it.

words.tr: v. 逐渐削弱；暗中损害；
words.ex: Constant criticism can undermine your confidence.
words.ex_cn: 不断的批评会逐渐削弱你的信心。
words.en: To undermine something means to weaken it or make it less effective, often in a gradual or sneaky way.

words.ex: We must eliminate the waste to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们必须消除浪费以保护环境。
words.en: To eliminate something, especially something you do not want or need, means to remove it completely.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: The rule excludes children under 12.
words.ex_cn: 这条规则排除了12岁以下的孩子。
words.en: To exclude someone or something means to prevent them from entering a place or taking part in an activity.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗衣店；
words.ex: I put the dirty laundry in the washing machine.
words.ex_cn: 我把脏衣服放进洗衣机里。
words.en: Laundry refers to the clothes and linens that need to be washed or that have just been washed. It can also refer to the place or business where clothes and linens are washed and ironed.

words.tr: adv. 显然；表面上看起来；
words.ex: He is apparently late for the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他显然迟到了会议。
words.en: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.

words.ex: He added gelatin to make the dessert firm.
words.ex_cn: 他加了明胶使甜点变硬。
words.en: Gelatin is a clear substance obtained from animal bones and used in food preparation, especially to make jelly, and in photographic processes.

words.ex: The bright light stimulated her eyes.
words.ex_cn: 强烈的光线刺激了她的眼睛。
words.en: To stimulate something means to encourage it to begin or develop further.

words.tr:
n. 燃料；燃油；
v. 加剧；
words.ex: The rocket uses fuel 627 for propulsion.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用627号燃料推进。
words.en: Fuel is a substance such as coal, gas, or oil that is burned to provide heat or power.

words.ex: The operational system runs smoothly every day.
words.ex_cn: 这个运作系统每天运行顺畅。
words.en: If a system or service is operational, it is working or able to be used.

words.tr: n. 图像；形象；画面；影像；
words.ex: The photo shows a clear image of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 这张照片展示了山脉的清晰图像。
words.en: An image is a picture that you have in your mind, especially about what someone or something is like or the way they look.

words.ex: The teacher will distribute the books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将把书分发给学生。
words.en: If you distribute things, you hand them or deliver them to a number of people.

words.ex: The notice board has a new message.
words.ex_cn: 公告板上有一条新消息。
words.en: A board on which notices are posted; a bulletin board.

words.ex: I intend to go to the park tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我打算明天去公园。
words.en: If you intend to do something, you have decided or planned to do it.

words.tr: adj. 经验主义的；以经验为根据的；
words.ex: The scientist used empirical data to support her theory.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家使用经验数据来支持她的理论。
words.en: Empirical evidence or study relies on practical experience rather than theories.

words.ex: He is on probation for one year.
words.ex_cn: 他被判缓刑一年。
words.en: Probation is a period of time during which someone who has committed a crime has to behave well and not commit any more crimes in order to avoid being sent to prison.

words.ex: He felt deep depression after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到深深的抑郁。
words.en: A period during which business, employment, and stock-market values decline severely or remain at a very low level of activity.

words.ex: The proximity of the school to the park makes it nice for kids.
words.ex_cn: 学校靠近公园，对孩子们来说很好。
words.en: Proximity refers to the state of being near in space or time.

words.ex: The child needs attention when he does homework.
words.ex_cn: 孩子做作业时需要被关注。
words.en: Attention is the act of focusing your mind on something and taking notice of it.

words.tr: adj. 根据事实的；真实的；
words.ex: His report is factual and accurate.
words.ex_cn: 他的报告是基于事实且准确的。
words.en: If something is factual, it is based on facts or concerns facts.

words.ex: The actor received acclaim for his performance.
words.ex_cn: 这位演员因他的表演而受到赞扬。
words.en: If someone or something is acclaimed, they are praised enthusiastically and publicly.

words.ex: He carries a bag to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天带一个包去学校。
words.en: To carry something means to move it while supporting it, especially in your hands or arms.

words.ex: The earthquake devastated the small town.
words.ex_cn: 地震摧毁了这个小镇。
words.en: To devastate means to destroy or ruin something completely, or to cause someone to feel extreme sadness or shock.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.ex: He wrote his postcode on the envelope.
words.ex_cn: 他把邮编写在了信封上。
words.en: A postcode is a sequence of letters and numbers which is part of an address and shows exactly where a place is.

words.tr: adj. 阴暗的；枯燥的；无趣的；
words.ex: The room was dull because the windows were covered.
words.ex_cn: 房间很阴暗，因为窗户被遮住了。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.

words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.ex: He lives in a tropical island near the equator.
words.ex_cn: 他住在赤道附近的一个热带岛屿上。
words.en: relating to or situated in or characteristic of the tropics (the region on either side of the equator)

words.tr:
n. 谣言
v. 谣传
words.ex: There is a rumour that he will quit his job.
words.ex_cn: 有一个传言说他要辞职。
words.en: A rumour is a story or piece of information that may or may not be true, but that people are talking about.

words.tr:
n. 尽力；尝试；
v. 尽力；奋力；
words.ex: His endeavor to finish the project took all his energy.
words.ex_cn: 他为完成这个项目付出了全部努力。
words.en: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

words.tr:
n. 地址；演讲；
v. 解决；向…讲话；
words.ex: Please write your address on the form.
words.ex_cn: 请把你的地址写在表格上。
words.en: The particulars of the place where someone lives or an organization is situated; a formal speech delivered to an audience.

words.ex: He made the payment online.
words.ex_cn: 他在线支付了。
words.en: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

words.ex: The food at this restaurant is superb.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅的食物极佳。
words.en: If something is superb, its quality is very good indeed.

words.ex: His intention was to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他的意图是帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An intention is an idea or plan of what you are going to do.

words.ex: The experiment demonstrates that water boils at 100°C.
words.ex_cn: 这个实验证明水在100摄氏度时沸腾。
words.en: To demonstrate means to show something clearly by giving proof or evidence.

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.ex: The lamp illuminate the dark room.
words.ex_cn: 这盏灯照亮了黑暗的房间。
words.en: To illuminate something means to shine light on it and to make it brighter and more visible.

words.tr: adj. 苗条的；纤细的；微小的；
words.ex: She has a slim figure.
words.ex_cn: 她身材苗条。
words.en: If someone is slim, they are thin in an attractive way.

words.ex: The evidence warrants a new investigation.
words.ex_cn: 证据使新的调查成为必要。
words.en: If something warrants a particular action, it makes the action seem necessary or appropriate for the circumstances.

words.tr: n. 乐观；乐观主义；乐观精神；
words.ex: His optimism helps him stay happy even when things are hard.
words.ex_cn: 他的乐观让他即使在困难时也能保持快乐。
words.en: Optimism is a feeling of hopefulness and confidence about the future or the success of something.

words.tr:
n. 等级；
v. 分等级；
words.ex: He earned a high rank in the army.
words.ex_cn: 他在军队中获得了很高的等级。
words.en: If you rank things or people, you arrange them in order of importance or quality. If someone or something ranks in a particular position, they are in that position on a scale that measures something such as importance or quality.

words.ex: The dimension of the box is 10 cm by 5 cm.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子的尺寸是10厘米乘5厘米。
words.en: A dimension is a measurement of something in a particular direction, or the scope or scale of something.

words.ex: He did not avail himself of the opportunity.
words.ex_cn: 他没有利用这个机会。
words.en: If you avail yourself of something, you use it or take advantage of it.

words.ex: Carbon dioxide makes the air warm.
words.ex_cn: 二氧化碳使空气变暖。
words.en: A compound containing two atoms of oxygen combined with another element or group.

words.tr:
n. 大楼；大厦；块；街区；障碍物；
v. 阻塞；阻碍；
words.ex: The new block is next to the park.
words.ex_cn: 这栋新大楼就在公园旁边。
words.en: A block is a large solid piece of material with flat surfaces on each side. As a verb, to block means to prevent movement or progress.

words.ex: The administrative office handles school records.
words.ex_cn: 行政办公室负责管理学校档案。
words.en: Relating to the management of a company, organization, or institution.

words.tr: adj. 令人沮丧的；令人泄气的；让人懊恼的； v. “frustrate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The slow internet is frustrating.
words.ex_cn: 网速慢让人沮丧。
words.en: If something is frustrating, it annoys you or makes you angry because you cannot do anything about the problems it causes.

words.ex: This plant is resistant to drought.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物对干旱有抵抗力。
words.en: If someone is resistant to something, they are opposed to it and want to prevent it.

words.ex: The book is overdue at the library.
words.ex_cn: 这本书在图书馆逾期了。
words.en: If you say that a change or an event is overdue, you mean that you think it should have happened before now.

words.ex: His speech was very impressive.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲非常令人印象深刻。
words.en: Something that is impressive makes you admire it because it is very good, large, important, etc.

words.ex: He did an analysis of the data.
words.ex_cn: 他对数据进行了分析。
words.en: Analysis is the process of considering something carefully or using statistical methods in order to understand it or explain it.

words.ex: The jury gave a guilty verdict.
words.ex_cn: 陪审团作出了有罪裁决。
words.en: A verdict is a decision made after a lot of consideration, especially one made by a jury in a court of law.

words.tr: n. 恢复精神的人或物；
words.ex: A short nap is a good refresher after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 午饭后小睡一会儿是恢复精神的好方法。
words.en: A refresher is a course that helps people to learn or remember something that they have already been taught, or something that makes you feel more energetic or less tired.

words.tr:
n. 烈火；火焰；闪耀
v. 闪耀；熊熊燃烧；发亮光
words.ex: The fire began to blaze in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 火在森林里开始猛烈燃烧。
words.en: A blaze is a very large or fiercely burning fire that is difficult to control.

words.ex: He misjudged the distance and crashed his bike.
words.ex_cn: 他误判了距离，撞上了自行车。
words.en: To form a wrong opinion or estimate about something or someone.

words.ex: She is pregnant and will have a baby next month.
words.ex_cn: 她怀孕了，下个月就要生宝宝了。
words.en: Having a baby developing in the uterus.

words.tr: adj. 不屈的；不屈服的；坚硬的
words.ex: He is unyielding in his decision.
words.ex_cn: 他在决定上毫不退让。
words.en: If you describe someone as unyielding, you mean that they are very determined and not likely to change their mind.

words.ex: The exterior of the house is painted white.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子的外观是白色的。
words.en: The outer surface or structure of something.

words.tr: v. 批准；认可；通过；赞成(连of)
words.ex: My mom will approve my new phone.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈会同意我买新手机。
words.en: If you approve of an action, event, or suggestion, you like it or are pleased about it.

words.ex: The lawyer helped her client with the contract.
words.ex_cn: 律师帮助她的客户处理合同。
words.en: A client is a person or organization receiving services or advice from a professional or company.

words.tr:
adj. 本国的；地方的
n. 方言；土语
words.ex: He wrote the poem in the vernacular language.
words.ex_cn: 他用本国语言写了这首诗。
words.en: The vernacular is the language or dialect spoken by the ordinary people in a particular country or region.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.ex: The glass is transparent.
words.ex_cn: 这玻璃是透明的。
words.en: If something is transparent, you can see through it.

words.ex: He played his favorite song on a cassette player.
words.ex_cn: 他用盒式磁带播放器播放了他最喜欢的歌。
words.en: A cassette is a small flat case containing a very long strip of magnetic material that is used to record sound or pictures.

words.ex: The deputy signed the document for the manager.
words.ex_cn: 代理人替经理签署了文件。
words.en: A deputy is a person who is appointed to act as a substitute for another, especially in a position of authority.

words.ex: The man was punished for fraud.
words.ex_cn: 这个人因欺骗而受到惩罚。
words.en: Fraud is the crime of gaining money or financial benefits by a trick or by lying.

words.ex: He bind the books with string.
words.ex_cn: 他用绳子把书捆起来。
words.en: To tie something or someone tightly or to fasten something.

words.ex: The flower has a sweet fragrance.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有一种甜美的香味。
words.en: A fragrance is a pleasant smell, especially that of a flower or perfume.

words.ex: The marketplace is full of fresh fruits and vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 市场上摆满了新鲜的水果和蔬菜。
words.en: A marketplace is an area in a town where a public market is held, or a situation or arena in which commercial dealings are conducted.

words.tr: adj. 敏锐的；急性的；严重的；
words.ex: He has an acute mind and solves problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他思维敏锐，能快速解决问题。
words.en: An acute problem or negative feeling is very severe.

words.ex: The apple is ripe and ready to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果熟了，可以吃了。
words.en: When fruit or crops are ripe, they are ready to be eaten or harvested because they have developed to the right stage.

words.tr:
n. 兽医；
v. 审查；
words.ex: The vet checked the dog's health.
words.ex_cn: 兽医检查了狗的健康状况。
words.en: A vet is a person who is qualified to treat sick or injured animals. As a verb, to vet means to examine something or someone carefully to make sure they are suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The teacher will formulate a new rule for class.
words.ex_cn: 老师将制定一条新的课堂规则。
words.en: If you formulate something such as a plan or proposal, you invent it, thinking about the details carefully.

words.ex: He collates the papers before the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议前整理了这些文件。
words.en: To collate information or data means to collect it together and examine it carefully in order to compare it or find something out.

words.ex: He inferred that she was tired from her yawns.
words.ex_cn: 他从她的哈欠推断出她很累。
words.en: If you infer that something is the case, you decide that it is true on the basis of information that you already have.

words.ex: He loves reading science fiction.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢读科幻小说。
words.en: Fiction refers to literature in the form of prose, especially novels, that describes imaginary events and people.

words.ex: He has the ability to solve math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他有能力快速解决数学问题。
words.en: The capacity to do something or the possession of the means or skill to do something.

words.ex: The health sector needs more funding.
words.ex_cn: 医疗部门需要更多资金。
words.en: A particular area of activity, especially one that is part of a larger area of activity or one that is considered separately from other areas.

words.ex: The cat creeps slowly toward the bird.
words.ex_cn: 猫蹑手蹑脚地向鸟靠近。
words.en: To move slowly and quietly, especially in a way that does not attract attention.

words.tr: adj. 随意的；非正式的；偶然的；
words.ex: He wore casual clothes to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他穿了随意的衣服去参加派对。
words.en: If you describe someone's attitude or behavior as casual, you mean they are not very concerned about what they are doing or what is happening around them, or they are not taking it seriously.

words.ex: The teacher gave a simple interpretation of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这首诗做了一个简单的解释。
words.en: An interpretation of something is an explanation or understanding of it.

words.ex: She starts her new job in the first trimester.
words.ex_cn: 她在第一个三个月期间开始新工作。
words.en: A trimester is a period of three months, especially one of the three three-month periods into which a human pregnancy is divided.

words.ex: The team reached a consensus on the project plan.
words.ex_cn: 团队就项目计划达成了共识。
words.en: A consensus is general agreement among a group of people.

words.tr: n. 重建；再发展；重建发展；
words.ex: The city plans redevelopment of the old downtown.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市计划对旧市中心进行重建。
words.en: The process of improving an area by building new houses, shops, or factories, or by repairing old ones.

words.ex: The school concert was held in the auditorium.
words.ex_cn: 学校的音乐会是在礼堂举行的。
words.en: An auditorium is the part of a theatre, concert hall, or other public building in which the audience sits.

words.ex: His condition improved after the treatment.
words.ex_cn: 他的状况在接受治疗后好转了。
words.en: A condition is a state of affairs that must exist or be brought about before something else can happen or be done.

words.tr: v. 布置家具；配备；供给；提供
words.ex: He will furnish the apartment with new furniture.
words.ex_cn: 他将为公寓配备新家具。
words.en: To furnish a place means to put furniture and other things into it.

words.ex: The doctor gave medicine to stabilise his blood pressure.
words.ex_cn: 医生给了药来稳定他的血压。
words.en: To stabilise something means to make it stable or to prevent it from changing or declining.

words.tr: adj. 即将开始的；新任的；
words.ex: The incoming class will start next week.
words.ex_cn: 即将开始的班级将在下周开课。
words.en: An incoming thing or person is arriving or being received.

words.ex: The engineer checked the alignment of the wheels.
words.ex_cn: 工程师检查了车轮的对齐。
words.en: The arrangement of something in a straight line or in correct relative positions.

words.ex: He put the suitcase in the boot of the car.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李箱放进了汽车的后备箱里。
words.en: A boot is a type of shoe that covers the whole foot and the lower part of the leg. It can also mean to kick something forcefully or to start a computer.

words.ex: The ozone layer protects us from the sun's harmful rays.
words.ex_cn: 臭氧层保护我们免受太阳有害射线的伤害。
words.en: The ozone layer is a layer in the Earth's stratosphere that contains a high concentration of ozone (O3) molecules, which absorb most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation.

words.tr:
n. 酸；
adj. 酸性的；
words.ex: The acid in lemon juice tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 柠檬汁中的酸味道很酸。
words.en: An acid is a chemical substance, usually a liquid, which contains hydrogen and can react with other substances to form salts. Some acids burn or dissolve other substances that they come into contact with.

words.tr: v. 快速发展；“boom”的现在分词； adj. 急速发展的；暴涨的；繁荣发展的；
words.ex: The tech industry is booming.
words.ex_cn: 科技行业正在快速发展。
words.en: Experiencing a period of great prosperity or rapid economic growth.

words.ex: He gave a definite answer to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了肯定的答案。
words.en: If something is definite, it is firm and clear, and unlikely to be changed.

words.ex: They deem this plan too risky.
words.ex_cn: 他们认为这个计划太冒险了。
words.en: If you deem something to be the case, you consider that it is the case.

words.ex: The narrator told the story in a calm voice.
words.ex_cn: 叙述者用平静的声音讲述了这个故事。
words.en: A narrator is a person who tells a story, or a person who speaks during a film or television program not as an actor but to describe or discuss the pictures being shown.

words.tr: v. 重新定位；使适应；改变方针；调整
words.ex: He had to reorient his goals after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他在失业后不得不重新调整自己的目标。
words.en: To change the focus or direction of something.

words.ex: I reckon it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我认为明天会下雨。
words.en: If you reckon that something is true, you think that it is true.

words.ex: He went to a tutorial to understand math better.
words.ex_cn: 他去参加辅导以更好地理解数学。
words.en: A tutorial is a period of teaching and discussion with a tutor, especially in a British university or college.

words.tr: n. 参考；提及；介绍信；引用；
words.ex: Please use this book for reference.
words.ex_cn: 请使用这本书作为参考。
words.en: A reference is a mention of something or someone, or a letter or statement about someone's character or abilities.

words.tr:
n. 雪橇；大锤
v. 乘雪橇；用大锤敲打
words.ex: The children rode on a sledge down the snowy hill.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们坐在雪橇上滑下雪坡。
words.en: A sledge is a vehicle that is used for traveling over snow and ice. It is typically pulled by animals or a motor.

words.ex: He exaggerates his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他夸张自己的成就来给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.ex: He abandoned his car in the snow.
words.ex_cn: 他把车抛弃在雪地里。
words.en: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

words.tr: n. 需优先考虑的事；优先权；
words.ex: Homework is my top priority.
words.ex_cn: 作业是我最需要优先考虑的事。
words.en: If something is a priority, it is the most important thing you have to do or deal with, or must be done or dealt with before everything else you have to do.

words.ex: The loud thunder terrified the child.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的雷声吓坏了那个孩子。
words.en: If something terrifies you, it makes you feel extremely frightened.

words.tr: n. 栖息地；居留地；产地；
words.ex: The panda's habitat is in the mountains of China.
words.ex_cn: 熊猫的栖息地在中国的山区。
words.en: The natural environment in which a species or group of species lives.

words.ex: My teacher encourages me to speak English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师鼓励我每天说英语。
words.en: If you encourage someone, you give them confidence, for example by letting them know that what they are doing is good and telling them that they should continue to do it.

words.ex: The celebrity smiled at the fans outside the theater.
words.ex_cn: 这位名人向剧院外的粉丝微笑。
words.en: A celebrity is a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports.

words.ex: The significance of this discovery changed science.
words.ex_cn: 这一发现的重要性改变了科学。
words.en: The quality of being worthy of attention; importance.

words.ex: The magnet has a magnetic force.
words.ex_cn: 这块磁铁有磁性。
words.en: If you describe something as magnetic, you mean that it is very attractive to people because it has unusual, powerful, and exciting qualities.

words.ex: The floor is slippery after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后地板很滑。
words.en: Something that is slippery is smooth, wet, or oily and is therefore difficult to walk on or to hold.

words.ex: The story had a graphic description of the battle.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事对战斗的描述非常生动。
words.en: A graphic is a visual representation of data or information, such as a chart, diagram, or picture.

words.ex: The police will examine the crime scene.
words.ex_cn: 警察将调查犯罪现场。
words.en: If you examine something, you look at it carefully.

words.ex: He got an opportunity to work abroad.
words.ex_cn: 他得到了一个去国外工作的机会。
words.en: An opportunity is a situation in which it is possible for you to do something that you want to do.

words.ex: The two colors distinguish the two teams.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色使两个队伍有所不同。
words.en: If you can distinguish one thing from another, you can see or understand how they are different.

words.tr:
n. 毛毯；厚的覆盖物；
adj. 包括所有的；
words.ex: He wrapped himself in a warm blanket.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己裹在一条温暖的毛毯里。
words.en: A blanket is a large piece of woolen or similar material used as a covering on a bed or elsewhere for warmth.

words.ex: His arrogance made others dislike him.
words.ex_cn: 他的傲慢让其他人不喜欢他。
words.en: Arrogance is the quality of being arrogant, which means having or revealing an exaggerated sense of one's own importance or abilities.

words.ex: The invention of the internet changed our era.
words.ex_cn: 互联网的发明改变了我们的时代。
words.en: An era is a period of time that is considered as a single unit because of a particular characteristic or event.

words.ex: The bright light was a stimulus for the baby to open his eyes.
words.ex_cn: 明亮的光线是让婴儿睁开眼睛的刺激物。
words.en: Something that causes growth or activity.

words.ex: The cat likes to roam around the garden.
words.ex_cn: 这只猫喜欢在花园里游荡。
words.en: To roam means to move about or travel without any definite purpose or destination.

words.tr: v. 提供；供应；“provide”的过去式和过去分词； conj. 如果；假如；在…条件下；
words.ex: The school provides free lunch to students.
words.ex_cn: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。
words.en: If a particular condition is true or if a particular event happens, then another condition will be true or another event will happen.

words.ex: The comparison of the two phones helped me decide.
words.ex_cn: 对这两部手机的比较帮助我做出了决定。
words.en: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences or similarities between them.

words.ex: The company got a lot of publicity from the TV ad.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司从电视广告中获得了大量宣传。
words.en: Publicity is the activity of making sure that someone or something attracts a lot of interest or attention from the public, especially by providing information about them in newspapers, on television, etc.

words.ex: Children depend on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

words.tr: n. 构成；作曲；（学生）作文；创作技巧；
words.ex: The composition of the rock includes sand and clay.
words.ex_cn: 这种岩石的构成包括沙子和黏土。
words.en: The way in which something is composed or arranged; the act of creating something, especially a piece of writing or music.

words.ex: He studies architecture at university.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学学习建筑学。
words.en: Architecture is the art and science of designing buildings and other physical structures.

words.tr:
n. 跨栏；障碍；难关
v. 越过障碍；克服
words.ex: He jumped over the hurdle quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他迅速跳过了跨栏。
words.en: A hurdle is a problem or difficulty that you must deal with before you can achieve something.

words.ex: Good teamwork helps the group finish the project faster.
words.ex_cn: 良好的团队合作帮助小组更快地完成项目。
words.en: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient.

words.ex: The ground is damp after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后地面是潮湿的。
words.en: Something that is damp is slightly wet, often in a way that is unpleasant.

words.ex: The staff at the hotel are very friendly.
words.ex_cn: 酒店的职员非常友好。
words.en: The people who work for a particular organization or company, or a group of officers assisting a commanding officer.

words.ex: The dove is a symbol of peace.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子是和平的象征。
words.en: A symbol is a shape or design that is used to represent something such as an idea, a quality, or a process.

words.ex: His answer was apt for the question.
words.ex_cn: 他的回答对这个问题很恰当。
words.en: If someone is apt to do something, they often do it and so it is likely that they will do it again.

words.ex: The mixture is homogeneous and looks the same throughout.
words.ex_cn: 这种混合物是均一的，看起来处处都一样。
words.en: Something that is homogeneous is uniform in nature or character throughout.

words.ex: We should conserve water in daily life.
words.ex_cn: 我们应在日常生活中节约用水。
words.en: To conserve something means to protect it from harm, loss, or change, especially in order to preserve it for the future.

words.tr: n. 痉挛；抽搐；一阵发作
words.ex: He had a spasm in his leg.
words.ex_cn: 他的腿抽筋了。
words.en: A spasm is a sudden and involuntary contraction of a muscle or group of muscles, often causing pain or discomfort.

words.ex: The ghost is invisible to the human eye.
words.ex_cn: 这个鬼魂肉眼看不见。
words.en: If something is invisible, you cannot see it because it is hidden or because it is very difficult to see.

words.ex: He devotes his time to helping children.
words.ex_cn: 他投入时间帮助孩子们。
words.en: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；给书籍、杂志等加插图；
words.ex: The teacher illustrated the point with a simple story.
words.ex_cn: 老师用一个简单的故事来举例说明这个观点。
words.en: To illustrate something means to explain or demonstrate it clearly, often by giving examples or by using pictures or diagrams.

words.ex: The house has a small terrace with chairs.
words.ex_cn: 这所房子有一个带椅子的小平台。
words.en: A terrace is a flat area of stone or grass next to a building where people can sit.

words.tr:
adj. 动态的；有活力的；不断变化的；
n. 活力；动力；
words.ex: The game has dynamic weather that changes every hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有每小时变化的动态天气。
words.en: If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new ideas.

words.tr:
prep. 遍及；各处；自始至终；
adv. 自始至终；到处；
words.ex: She traveled throughout the country.
words.ex_cn: 她遍及全国旅行。
words.en: In every part of a place or thing; during the whole of a period of time.

words.tr: adj. 聪明的；时髦的；衣冠楚楚的；
words.ex: He is a smart student who solves math problems quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个聪明的学生，能快速解决数学问题。
words.en: If you describe someone as smart, you mean that they are clean, tidy, and stylish in their appearance.

words.ex: The teacher criticise the student for not doing homework.
words.ex_cn: 老师批评学生没有做作业。
words.en: If you criticise someone or something, you express your disapproval of them by saying what you think is wrong with them.

words.ex: The answer is beyond my understanding.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案超出了我的理解。
words.en: If something is beyond a place or barrier, it is on the other side of it.

words.ex: The small town is located in the hinterland of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇位于该国的内地。
words.en: The area lying inland from a coast or the shore of a river; the backcountry.

words.tr: n. 烟雾；烟气；“fume”的复数； v. 大为生气；
words.ex: The car released black fumes from its exhaust.
words.ex_cn: 汽车从排气管冒出黑烟。
words.en: Fumes are the strong, often unpleasant smell or smoke that is given off by a substance.

words.ex: He has a positive attitude toward life.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活持积极的态度。
words.en: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

words.tr: adj. 角的；有角的；尖角的；
words.ex: The angular shape of the triangle is clear.
words.ex_cn: 三角形的角形很清晰。
words.en: having angles or sharp corners; lean and bony

words.tr:
n. 大炮；火炮
v. 猛撞；碰撞
words.ex: The soldiers fired the cannon at the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们向敌人开炮。
words.en: A cannon is a large, heavy piece of artillery which was used in wars to fire heavy metal balls or shells.

words.ex: He felt an obligation to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他感到有义务帮助他的朋友。
words.en: An obligation is something that you must do because you have promised, because of a law, etc.

words.ex: He plays hockey every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末打冰球。
words.en: Hockey is a sport played on ice or on a field, in which two teams try to hit a small hard object called a puck or a ball into the other team's goal using long curved sticks.

words.ex: The address is 720 liberty street.
words.ex_cn: 地址是自由大街720号。
words.en: The state of being free within society from oppressive restrictions imposed by authority on one's way of life, behavior, or political views.

words.ex: Farmers use pesticide to kill insects on crops.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用杀虫剂来杀死作物上的昆虫。
words.en: A pesticide is a chemical substance used to kill pests, especially insects, that damage crops or are harmful to human health.

words.ex: The poll showed that most people support the new law.
words.ex_cn: 这项民意调查表明，大多数人支持这项新法律。
words.en: A poll is a survey in which people are asked their opinions about something, usually in order to find out how popular something is or what people intend to do in the future.

words.tr: adj. 可归还的；可退还的；
words.ex: The deposit is refundable if you return the item.
words.ex_cn: 如果你退回物品，押金是可以退还的。
words.en: If something is refundable, it means that the money you have paid for it can be returned to you under certain conditions.

words.ex: He felt homesick after moving to a new city.
words.ex_cn: 他搬到新城市后感到想家。
words.en: If you are homesick, you feel unhappy because you are away from home and are missing your family, friends, and home very much.

words.tr: adj. 有同情心的；表示怜悯的；
words.ex: She is a compassionate teacher who helps struggling students.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位有同情心的老师，帮助学习困难的学生。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as compassionate, you mean that they feel or show pity, sympathy, and understanding for people who are suffering.

words.ex: He used the map to orientate himself.
words.ex_cn: 他用地图来确定自己的位置。
words.en: To orientate means to align or position something relative to the points of a compass or other specified positions. It can also mean to familiarize someone with a new situation or environment.

words.ex: His insight helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的洞察力帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

words.ex: He tried to resist the temptation to eat sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抵制吃甜食的诱惑。
words.en: If you resist something such as a change, you refuse to accept it and try to prevent it.

words.ex: The bird glide smoothly over the lake.
words.ex_cn: 鸟儿在湖面上滑行。
words.en: To move smoothly and continuously along, as if without effort or resistance.

words.ex: The accident caused many casualties.
words.ex_cn: 这场事故造成了许多伤亡人员。
words.en: A casualty is a person who is killed or injured in a war or in an accident.

words.ex: His belief in honesty never changed.
words.ex_cn: 他对诚实的信念从未改变。
words.en: A belief is a strong feeling that something is true or exists.

words.ex: He showed great concentration while solving the math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在解这道数学题时非常专注。
words.en: Concentration is the ability to focus all your attention on one thing without being distracted.

words.tr:
n. 用力拉；拖拽；拖船
v. 用力拉；使劲拖；拖拽
words.ex: He gave a strong tug on the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他用力拉了绳子一下。
words.en: If you tug something or tug at it, you give it a quick and usually strong pull.

words.ex: After the break, we will proceed with the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 休息后，我们将继续开会。
words.en: If you proceed to do something, you continue to do it or start to do it after doing something else first.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: He bought a new mattress for his bed.
words.ex_cn: 他为床买了一个新床垫。
words.en: A mattress is a large, flat pad that is placed on a bed to make it comfortable to sleep on.

words.ex: The hostile neighbor shouted at us every morning.
words.ex_cn: 那个敌意的邻居每天早上都对我们大喊大叫。
words.en: If you are hostile to another person or an idea, you disagree with them or disapprove of them, often showing this in your behavior.

words.ex: The teacher intervened when the students argued.
words.ex_cn: 当学生们争吵时，老师进行了干涉。
words.en: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

words.tr: v. 促进；推动；宣传；推销；
words.ex: Exercise can promote good health.
words.ex_cn: 锻炼可以促进健康。
words.en: To promote means to help something to happen, develop, or increase, or to raise someone to a higher position or rank.

words.tr:
v. 撞；碰上；颠簸行进；
n. 碰撞；猛击；肿块；凸块；
words.ex: He bumped the table and spilled his drink.
words.ex_cn: 他撞到了桌子，打翻了饮料。
words.en: If you bump into something or someone, you accidentally hit them while you are moving.

words.ex: The family had a reunion last Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 这家人上个星期天举行了团聚。
words.en: A reunion is a gathering of people who have been separated, especially members of a family or old friends, coming together again.

words.ex: The digestive system breaks down food.
words.ex_cn: 消化系统分解食物。
words.en: Relating to the process of digesting food.

words.ex: I live with a local family during my homestay.
words.ex_cn: 我在寄宿家庭期间和一个当地家庭住在一起。
words.en: A homestay is a form of tourism and/or study abroad program that allows the visitor to rent a room from a local family to better learn the local lifestyle as well as improve their language ability.

words.tr: v. 承诺；犯（罪、错）；（公开地）表达意见；
words.ex: He commit to help his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺帮助他的朋友。
words.en: To commit means to carry out or perpetrate a mistake, crime, or immoral act; or to pledge or bind oneself to a certain course of action.

words.ex: He is practically always late for class.
words.ex_cn: 他几乎总是上课迟到。
words.en: In a way that is almost true or almost the case; virtually.

words.tr: n. 杂技演员；立场观点善变的人
words.ex: The acrobat jumps high on the tightrope.
words.ex_cn: 杂技演员在钢丝上跳得很高。
words.en: An acrobat is someone who entertains people by performing difficult physical acts such as jumping and balancing, especially in a circus.

words.ex: The company's revenue increased last year.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的收入去年增加了。
words.en: Revenue is the income that a company, organization, or government receives regularly.

words.ex: The coin is made of nickel.
words.ex_cn: 这枚硬币是镍制的。
words.en: A hard silver-white metal that is used in making alloys and is a chemical element. It is also a coin worth five cents in the US and Canada.

words.tr:
v. 跛行；蹒跚；瘸着走
adj. 无力的；无生气的
words.ex: He limps after hurting his leg.
words.ex_cn: 他受伤后走路一瘸一拐。
words.en: If someone limps, they walk with difficulty or in an uneven way because one of their legs or feet is hurt.

words.tr:
v. 喷吐；吐痰；吐口水
n. 唾沫；一块陆地；烤肉叉
words.ex: He likes to spit watermelon seeds.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吐西瓜籽。
words.en: To spit means to force out the contents of the mouth, especially saliva, through the lips. It can also refer to the act of ejecting saliva or phlegm from the mouth, often as a gesture of contempt or disrespect.

words.tr: n. 不规则；无规律；不合常规；不整齐
words.ex: The teacher noticed an irregularity in the test scores.
words.ex_cn: 老师注意到考试成绩中有一个异常。
words.en: The state or quality of being irregular; something that is irregular.

words.ex: A gentle breeze blew through the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一阵微风轻轻吹过树梢。
words.en: A breeze is a gentle wind.

words.ex: There are many shops on this avenue.
words.ex_cn: 这条大街上有许多商店。
words.en: An avenue is a wide street or main thoroughfare, often lined with trees or other landscaping.

words.ex: The microscope can magnify small objects.
words.ex_cn: 显微镜可以放大微小的物体。
words.en: To magnify something means to make it appear larger than it is, especially by using a lens or microscope. It can also mean to exaggerate or make something seem more important or serious than it really is.

words.ex: The bees built a hive in the tree.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂在树上建了一个蜂巢。
words.en: A hive is a structure where bees live, consisting of a series of cells in which they store honey and raise their young.

words.ex: Rust is an oxide of iron.
words.ex_cn: 铁锈是铁的氧化物。
words.en: An oxide is a chemical compound that contains at least one oxygen atom and one other element in its chemical formula.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the calf every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂小牛。
words.en: A calf is a young cow or bull. It can also refer to the fleshy part of the back of the human leg below the knee.

words.tr:
adj. 最重要的；
adv. 首要地；
words.ex: He is the foremost expert in this field.
words.ex_cn: 他是这个领域最重要的专家。
words.en: Most important or prominent; leading.

words.ex: Follow the procedure step by step.
words.ex_cn: 一步一步地按照步骤进行。
words.en: A procedure is a way of doing something, especially the usual or correct way.

words.ex: He will assemble the toy for his son.
words.ex_cn: 他将为儿子组装玩具。
words.en: If people assemble or if someone assembles them, they come together in a group, usually for a particular purpose such as a meeting.

words.ex: He was punished for plagiarism in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他因论文剽窃而受到惩罚。
words.en: Plagiarism is the practice of using or copying someone else's idea or work and pretending that you thought of it or created it.

words.tr:
v. 奔驰；飞奔
n. 奔驰；飞奔
words.ex: The horse gallops across the field.
words.ex_cn: 马在田野上疾驰。
words.en: If a horse gallops, it runs very fast so that all four legs are off the ground at the same time in each stride.

words.ex: He made a pledge to help the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了帮助穷人的保证。
words.en: A pledge is a serious promise or agreement, especially one made publicly or officially. It can also refer to something given as security for the fulfillment of a contract or the payment of a debt.

words.ex: This medicine is effective against colds.
words.ex_cn: 这种药对感冒有效。
words.en: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.ex: He denies taking the money.
words.ex_cn: 他否认拿了钱。
words.en: To deny means to declare that something is not true, or to refuse to give or grant something.

words.ex: The two countries formed a union to strengthen trade.
words.ex_cn: 这两个国家组成了一个联盟以加强贸易。
words.en: An organization of workers formed to protect their rights and interests; the act of joining two or more things together.

words.ex: He took responsibility for the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他承担了这个错误的责任。
words.en: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

words.ex: He conform to the rules of the school.
words.ex_cn: 他遵守学校的规章制度。
words.en: To conform means to behave in a way that is accepted by most people or to obey a rule, law, or custom.

words.ex: A pocket calculator is handy for math problems.
words.ex_cn: 便携式计算器对于数学问题很方便。
words.en: If something is handy, it is useful and easy to use or to reach.

words.ex: The teacher will notify the students about the test.
words.ex_cn: 老师会通知学生们关于考试的事。
words.en: If you notify someone of something, you officially inform them about it.

words.tr: adj. 壮观的；辉煌的；极好的；
words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was splendid.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落非常壮观。
words.en: If you say that something is splendid, you mean that it is very good.

words.ex: He asked for the direction to the station.
words.ex_cn: 他问了去车站的方向。
words.en: A direction is the way that you have to travel to get from one place to another, or the way that something is moving or pointing.

words.ex: The computer will execute the program quickly.
words.ex_cn: 计算机将快速执行该程序。
words.en: To execute means to carry out or put into effect a plan, order, or course of action. It can also refer to the act of legally killing someone as a punishment.

words.tr:
v. 见证；
n. 证人；目击者；
words.ex: He witnessed the accident yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天目睹了那起事故。
words.en: A witness is someone who sees an event happen, especially a crime or an accident. Witnesses are often called upon to give evidence in court.

words.tr:
n. 肘部
v. 用肘推挤
words.ex: He hurt his elbow while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他在打篮球时伤了肘部。
words.en: The joint between the forearm and the upper arm; to push someone with your elbow.

words.tr: adj. 有限的； v. 限制；“limit”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: We have limited time to finish the project.
words.ex_cn: 我们完成这个项目的时间是有限的。
words.en: If something is limited, there is only a certain amount of it.

words.ex: The fishing vessel sailed out at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 那艘渔船在黎明时出海。
words.en: A vessel is a large boat or a container for holding liquids.

words.ex: He keeps his diary private.
words.ex_cn: 他把日记保密。
words.en: If something is private, it is for the use of one person or group, rather than for the general public.

words.tr:
n. 立体声；立体声音响
adj. 立体声的
words.ex: He plays music on the stereo.
words.ex_cn: 他通过立体声收音机播放音乐。
words.en: A stereo is a sound system that uses two or more separate microphones to record sound and two or more loudspeakers to play it back, so that you hear different parts of the sound coming from different directions.

words.tr:
n. 浸泡；
v. 吸收；
words.ex: The clothes went into a soak overnight.
words.ex_cn: 衣服泡了一整晚。
words.en: To soak something means to make it very wet by leaving it in a liquid, or to become very wet in this way. It can also mean to absorb or take in something.

words.ex: The old tree has a stout trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵老树有一个粗壮的树干。
words.en: Someone who is stout is rather fat or heavy.

words.ex: The greasy pan needed a good wash.
words.ex_cn: 这个油污的平底锅需要好好洗一洗。
words.en: Something that is greasy has a lot of grease or oil on it or in it.

words.tr: v. 自夸；夸耀；自豪地拥有
words.ex: He boasts about his new car.
words.ex_cn: 他夸耀自己的新车。
words.en: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.

words.tr:
adj. 迅速的；敏捷的；快的；
n. 雨燕；
words.ex: The swift runner won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位迅速的跑步者赢得了比赛。
words.en: moving or capable of moving at great speed, or happening within a very short time; fast.

words.ex: His ignorance of the rules caused the mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他对规则的无知导致了这个错误。
words.en: Lack of knowledge or information.

words.ex: The painting has a simple aesthetic appeal.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画有一种简单的审美吸引力。
words.en: Concerned with beauty or the appreciation of beauty.

words.tr:
n. 屏幕；屏风；掩蔽物；
v. 筛查；掩蔽；
words.ex: The movie is playing on the screen.
words.ex_cn: 电影正在屏幕上播放。
words.en: A screen is a flat surface on which pictures or words are shown, such as the one on a television or computer. It can also refer to a partition used to divide or protect an area. As a verb, to screen means to examine something in order to decide whether it is suitable for a particular purpose, or to protect someone or something from something harmful or unpleasant.

words.ex: He was absent from school yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天缺席了学校。
words.en: If someone or something is absent from a place or situation where they should be or where they usually are, they are not there.

words.tr:
v. 刮；擦；刮出刺耳声；勉强通过
n. 刮；擦；擦痕；刮擦声
words.ex: He scraped his knee on the rough ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在粗糙的地面上擦伤了膝盖。
words.en: To remove something from a surface using a sharp or rough edge, or to injure a part of the body by rubbing it against a rough surface.

words.ex: The new policy is for the promotion of clean energy.
words.ex_cn: 这项新政策是为了促进清洁能源。
words.en: A promotion is a move to a more important job or rank in a company or organization.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: He specialises in repairing old clocks.
words.ex_cn: 他专用于修理老式钟表。
words.en: To concentrate on and become expert in a particular subject or skill.

words.ex: The sunset over the mountains was magnificent.
words.ex_cn: 山上的日落壮丽极了。
words.en: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

words.tr: adj. 痉挛的；间歇的；一阵阵的
words.ex: He had spasmodic coughing at night.
words.ex_cn: 他晚上有阵发性的咳嗽。
words.en: Something that is spasmodic happens suddenly and irregularly, often in short periods of time.

words.tr:
n. 基金；资金；
v. 提供资金；
words.ex: The school raised a fund for new books.
words.ex_cn: 学校为购买新书筹集了一笔基金。
words.en: A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose.

words.ex: I perceive a change in his mood.
words.ex_cn: 我察觉到他的情绪有变化。
words.en: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

words.ex: The manufacturer makes cars in this factory.
words.ex_cn: 这家制造商在这家工厂生产汽车。
words.en: A manufacturer is a person or company that produces goods in large quantities, especially in a factory.

words.ex: The engineer checked the specification for the machine.
words.ex_cn: 工程师检查了机器的规格。
words.en: A specification is a detailed description of the design and materials used to make something.

words.ex: I checked the class schedule for tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我查看了明天的课程时间表。
words.en: A schedule is a plan that gives a list of events or tasks and the times at which each one should happen or be done.

words.ex: We made an arrangement to meet at 6 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我们安排好晚上六点见面。
words.en: An arrangement is a plan or preparation which you make so that something can happen.

words.tr: n. 毁灭；引起毁灭的根源；
words.ex: The storm caused the destruction of the village.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴摧毁了村庄。
words.en: The act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

words.ex: He picked up the fire extinguisher to put out the flames.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起灭火器来扑灭火焰。
words.en: An extinguisher is a device that is used to put out fires.

words.ex: I assume it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我假定明天会下雨。
words.en: If you assume that something is true, you accept that it is true without proof.

words.ex: The proportion of students who passed the test was high.
words.ex_cn: 通过考试的学生比例很高。
words.en: A proportion is a part of a whole, or the relationship of one part to another in terms of size, amount, or degree.

words.ex: He walked forth to meet the sun.
words.ex_cn: 他向前走去迎接太阳。
words.en: Forward in time, place, or order; onward.

words.tr: n. 裁判；介绍人；仲裁者
words.ex: The referee blew the whistle for a foul.
words.ex_cn: 裁判吹哨判罚犯规。
words.en: A referee is an official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are adhered to and sometimes to arbitrate on matters arising from the play.

words.ex: He will forgo dessert to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 为了保持健康，他将放弃甜点。
words.en: If you forgo something, you decide to do without it, even though you would like it.

words.tr: n. （大学）研究生助教奖学金
words.ex: He got an assistantship to help with research.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了一份助教职位来协助研究。
words.en: An assistantship is a position of a graduate student that involves teaching or research duties in exchange for financial support.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: The teacher gave me a recommendation for the scholarship.
words.ex_cn: 老师给我写了一封奖学金推荐信。
words.en: A suggestion or proposal as to the best course of action, especially one put forward by an authoritative body.

words.ex: He drew a graph to show the temperature changes.
words.ex_cn: 他画了一个图表来显示温度变化。
words.en: A graph is a mathematical diagram which shows the relationship between two or more sets of numbers or measurements.

words.ex: The rain offset the heat yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天的雨抵消了炎热。
words.en: If one thing is offset by another, the effect of the first thing is reduced by the second, so that any advantage or disadvantage is cancelled out.

words.tr: n. 人性；人类；人道；仁慈；
words.ex: Kindness shows the best of humanity.
words.ex_cn: 善良展现了人性中最美好的一面。
words.en: Humanity refers to all human beings collectively or the qualities that make us human, such as kindness, compassion, and the ability to reason.

words.ex: The vase remained intact after the fall.
words.ex_cn: 花瓶从高处摔下后依然完整无缺。
words.en: Something that is intact is complete and has not been damaged or changed.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: The mechanical toy moves with batteries.
words.ex_cn: 这个机械玩具用电池驱动。
words.en: Relating to machines or machinery; operated by or involving a machine or machines.

words.ex: The car stopped at the junction.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在交叉路口停了下来。
words.en: A junction is a place where two or more things, especially roads or railways, come together.

words.ex: He takes a siesta after lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午饭后小睡一会儿。
words.en: A siesta is a short sleep or rest which you have in the early afternoon, especially in hot countries.

words.ex: I can detect a change in her mood.
words.ex_cn: 我能察觉到她情绪的变化。
words.en: To detect something means to find it or discover it, often using special equipment or methods.

words.ex: We took a detour to avoid the traffic.
words.ex_cn: 我们绕道以避开交通拥堵。
words.en: A detour is a longer, less direct way to go somewhere, used to avoid a problem or to visit something along the way.

words.ex: He walked up the staircase to his room.
words.ex_cn: 他走上楼梯去了他的房间。
words.en: A staircase is a set of stairs inside a building, often including the supporting structure, the handrails, and sometimes the landings at the top and bottom.

words.ex: He has arthritis in his hands.
words.ex_cn: 他双手有关节炎。
words.en: Arthritis is a medical condition in which the joints in someone's body are swollen and painful.

words.ex: The fence is a barrier to animals.
words.ex_cn: 这道围栏是动物的障碍。
words.en: A barrier is something such as a rule, law, or policy that makes it difficult or impossible for something to happen or be achieved.

words.ex: He will replace the broken chair.
words.ex_cn: 他将代替这把坏掉的椅子。
words.en: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: He needs a visa to travel to Japan.
words.ex_cn: 他需要一张签证去日本旅行。
words.en: A visa is an official document, or a stamp put in your passport, which allows you to enter or leave a particular country.

words.ex: The cosmic rays come from outer space.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙射线来自外太空。
words.en: Relating to the universe or cosmos, especially as distinct from the earth.

words.tr: adj. 可展开的；可延伸的；可延展的；
words.ex: This table is extendable, so it can fit more people.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是可展开的，因此可以容纳更多人。
words.en: Capable of being extended or stretched out.

words.ex: There is an abundance of food at the party.
words.ex_cn: 聚会上食物非常丰富。
words.en: A very large quantity of something.

words.ex: The supervisor checked the workers' progress.
words.ex_cn: 主管检查了工人们的进展。
words.en: A supervisor is a person who oversees and directs the work of others.

words.tr:
v. 使混乱；使杂乱
n. 杂乱；混乱
words.ex: He jumbled the letters and could not read the word.
words.ex_cn: 他把字母弄乱了，无法认出这个单词。
words.en: To mix things together in a confused or untidy way.

words.ex: The school will equip the lab with new computers.
words.ex_cn: 学校将为实验室配备新电脑。
words.en: To provide someone or something with the necessary items for a particular purpose.

words.ex: He made a permanent change to his lifestyle.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的生活方式做出了永久的改变。
words.en: Something that is permanent exists or happens all the time, or exists for a long time without changing.

words.ex: He embeds the photo in the document.
words.ex_cn: 他把照片插入到文档中。
words.en: To fix something firmly and deeply in a surrounding mass.

words.tr: n. 入学介绍；岗前训练；方向；取向；
words.ex: The school held an orientation for new students on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 学校在周一为新生举行了入学介绍。
words.en: The act of orienting or the state of being oriented; the determination of the relative position of something or someone (especially oneself).

words.ex: The storm deprived us of electricity.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴剥夺了我们的电力。
words.en: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it.

words.ex: The magic show amazed the children.
words.ex_cn: 魔术表演让孩子们感到惊奇。
words.en: To amaze someone means to surprise them very much.

words.tr: n. 被除数；股份红利；股息
words.ex: In 12 ÷ 3 = 4, the dividend is 12.
words.en: A dividend is a sum of money paid regularly (typically annually) by a company to its shareholders out of its profits (or reserves).

words.ex: He has a preference for tea over coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他更喜欢茶而不是咖啡。
words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.tr:
n. 合同；契约；
v. 收缩；
words.ex: They signed a contract to buy the house.
words.ex_cn: 他们签署了一份购买房子的合同。
words.en: A contract is a legal agreement between two or more parties. It can also mean to become smaller or tighter, or to catch a disease.

words.ex: He felt uneasy when he heard the strange noise.
words.ex_cn: 当他听到奇怪的声音时，他感到不安。
words.en: If you are uneasy, you feel anxious, afraid, or embarrassed, because you think that something is wrong or that there is danger.

words.ex: The door opens automatically when you get close.
words.ex_cn: 当你靠近时，门会自动打开。
words.en: If something happens automatically, it happens as a part of the normal process or system, without needing to be started by someone.

words.tr:
adj. 女性的；雌性的；
n. 雌性；女性；
words.ex: The female teacher is very kind.
words.ex_cn: 这位女老师非常和蔼。
words.en: A female is a person or animal that belongs to the sex that can have babies or produce eggs.

words.tr: n. 有价值的人或物；长处；
words.ex: He is an asset to the team because he works hard.
words.ex_cn: 他是个有价值的人，因为他工作努力。
words.en: An asset is something valuable that an individual, corporation, or country owns or controls with the expectation that it will provide a future benefit.

words.tr: n. 运动员；田径运动员；
words.ex: The athlete ran fast and won the race.
words.ex_cn: 这位运动员跑得很快，赢得了比赛。
words.en: An athlete is a person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

words.ex: The clarity of her explanation helped everyone understand.
words.ex_cn: 她解释的清晰帮助了每个人理解。
words.en: Clarity is the quality of being clear, in particular the quality of being easy to understand or see.

words.tr:
v. 交换；
n. 交换；
words.ex: They swap books every week.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周交换书籍。
words.en: If you swap something with someone, you give it to them and receive a different thing in exchange.

words.tr: adj. 精密复杂的；老练的；
words.ex: The phone has a sophisticated camera.
words.ex_cn: 这部手机有一个精密复杂的摄像头。
words.en: A sophisticated person is intelligent and knows a lot, so that they are able to understand complicated situations. A sophisticated machine, device, or method is more advanced or complex than others.

words.ex: The bulk of the students passed the exam.
words.ex_cn: 大部分学生通过了考试。
words.en: The bulk of something is most of it. The bulk of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

words.tr: n. 机械（总称）；机械装置；
words.ex: The factory uses old machinery to produce goods.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂使用旧机械来生产产品。
words.en: Machinery refers to machines in general or the parts of a machine that make it work.

words.ex: They have an intimate friendship.
words.ex_cn: 他们有着亲密的友谊。
words.en: having a close, friendly, or personal relationship with someone; private and personal

words.ex: The law restricts driving after drinking.
words.ex_cn: 法律限制酒后驾驶。
words.en: to limit the movements or actions of someone, or to limit something and reduce its size or prevent it from increasing

words.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。
words.en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.

words.ex: He has the calibre to lead the team.
words.ex_cn: 他有领导团队的能力。
words.en: The quality of someone's character or the level of their ability; the diameter of the inside of a tube, especially of a gun barrel.

words.ex: The desert has a harsh climate.
words.ex_cn: 沙漠的气候非常严酷。
words.en: If you describe something as harsh, you mean that it is extremely difficult and unpleasant to live in, do, or experience, especially because it is very cold, hot, or violent.

words.ex: The parliament passed a new law about education.
words.ex_cn: 国会通过了一项关于教育的新法律。
words.en: A parliament is a legislative body of government, typically composed of elected representatives, that is responsible for making laws and representing the interests of the people.

words.tr: n. 航班；飞行；（阶梯的）一段；
words.ex: The flight to Beijing leaves at 8 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 飞往北京的航班早上8点起飞。
words.en: A flight is a journey made by flying, usually in an aircraft.

words.ex: Please remind me to call my mom tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 请提醒我明天给我妈妈打电话。
words.en: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

words.tr: n. 水族馆；水族箱；养鱼缸；
words.ex: We visited the aquarium to see the fish.
words.ex_cn: 我们去水族馆看鱼。
words.en: A tank or building in which fish and other water creatures and plants are kept.

words.tr: n. 单元格；细胞；牢房；小房间；
words.ex: Each cell in the spreadsheet holds a number.
words.ex_cn: 电子表格中的每个单元格都包含一个数字。
words.en: A cell is the smallest structural and functional unit of an organism, typically microscopic and consisting of cytoplasm and a nucleus enclosed in a membrane. It can also refer to a small room in which a prisoner is locked up or a device for producing electricity from chemical reactions.

words.ex: The cave dweller lives alone in the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 洞穴居民独自住在山里。
words.en: A dweller is a person or animal that lives in or at a specified place.

words.ex: The president will declare a holiday next week.
words.ex_cn: 总统将在下周宣布放假。
words.en: If you declare something, you state it formally, publicly, or officially.

words.ex: He packed his clothes into a suitcase.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服装进了行李箱。
words.en: A suitcase is a case with a handle and often with wheels, used for carrying clothes and possessions when travelling.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: The old woman predict rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 那位老妇人预言明天会下雨。
words.en: If you predict an event, you say that it will happen.

words.tr: n. 总部；司令部；指挥部；
words.ex: The company's headquarters is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: The main office or center of control of a company, organization, or military unit.

words.tr: phrase. 覆盖范围的文字说明；用于描述某项服务或产品覆盖区域的标注文字
words.ex: The map includes a coverage lettering that explains the service areas.
words.ex_cn: 这张地图包含了一段文字说明，解释了服务范围。
words.en: Text or lettering used to describe or provide information about an insurance policy's coverage.

words.ex: The police enforce the law.
words.ex_cn: 警察强制执行法律。
words.en: If people in authority enforce a law or a rule, they make sure that it is obeyed, usually by punishing people who do not obey it.

words.ex: This restaurant is famous for its specialty, fried dumplings.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅以特色菜煎饺而闻名。
words.en: A specialty is a particular area of study or expertise that someone has, or a product that is particularly associated with a specific place.

words.tr: adj. 固有的；内在的；本身的；
