words.en: To compose something means to make it by combining parts or elements.

words.tr: phrase. 白费地； 徒劳地
words.ex: He cried in vain for help.
words.ex_cn: 他呼救却无济于事。
words.en: If you do something in vain, you do not succeed in achieving what you intend.

words.ex: The cat ran down the alley.
words.ex_cn: 猫跑进了小巷。
words.en: An alley is a narrow passage between buildings or other structures.

words.ex: The dolphin jumped high out of the water.
words.ex_cn: 海豚从水中高高跳起。
words.en: A dolphin is a marine mammal that is known for its intelligence and friendly nature towards humans.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.ex: The teacher stood on the platform to speak.
words.ex_cn: 老师站在平台上讲话。
words.en: A platform is a flat, raised structure, usually made of wood, which people stand on when they make speeches or give performances.

words.ex: The atmosphere keeps the Earth warm.
words.ex_cn: 大气使地球保持温暖。
words.en: The atmosphere is the layer of gases surrounding a planet or other material body, held in place by the gravity of the body.

words.ex: The boss appointed Tom as the new manager.
words.ex_cn: 老板任命汤姆为新经理。
words.en: If you appoint someone to a job or official position, you formally choose them for it.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: He can identify the bird by its song.
words.ex_cn: 他能通过鸟的叫声识别它。
words.en: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

words.ex: The village is at an altitude of 2,000 meters.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄的海拔是2000米。
words.en: The height of an object or point in relation to sea level or ground level.

words.ex: He possesses a small house near the lake.
words.ex_cn: 他拥有一栋靠近湖边的小房子。
words.en: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

words.ex: The children felt excitement before the birthday party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在生日派对前感到兴奋。
words.en: A feeling of great enthusiasm and eagerness.

words.ex: His words are a contradiction.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: A contradiction is a situation or statement in which two aspects or elements are opposed to each other, making it impossible for both to be true at the same time.

words.ex: He made a painstaking effort to fix the small details.
words.ex_cn: 他细心地努力修正每一个小细节。
words.en: If you describe someone's work as painstaking, you mean that they do it very carefully and thoroughly, often taking a long time.

words.ex: His pursuit of happiness made him work hard every day.
words.ex_cn: 他对幸福的追求让他每天努力工作。
words.en: The act of pursuing something or someone, especially in order to catch or achieve them.

words.tr: adj. 人道主义的；人文主义的；
words.ex: The teacher has a humanistic approach to student care.
words.ex_cn: 这位老师对学生关怀具有人道主义的态度。
words.en: Humanistic refers to a system of thought that focuses on human beings and their values, capacities, and worth, emphasizing the importance of human values rather than religious or spiritual matters.

words.ex: His speech was coherent and easy to understand.
words.ex_cn: 他的演讲连贯且易于理解。
words.en: If something is coherent, it is well planned, so that it is clear and sensible and all its parts go well with each other.

words.ex: His outlook on life is very positive.
words.ex_cn: 他对生活的观点非常积极。
words.en: Your outlook is your general attitude towards life.

words.ex: The teacher apportioned the books equally among the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师把书平均分给了学生们。
words.en: To apportion something is to divide it and share it out among several people or things.

words.ex: The finitude of resources limits our choices.
words.ex_cn: 资源的限制限制了我们的选择。
words.en: The state of being finite or having limits.

words.ex: Oil is an exhaustible resource.
words.ex_cn: 石油是一种用得尽的资源。
words.en: If something is exhaustible, it can be used up completely.

words.tr: n. 揭露；被揭示的真相；
words.ex: The letter was a revelation about his secret life.
words.ex_cn: 这封信揭露了他隐秘的生活。
words.en: A revelation is a surprising and previously unknown fact that has been disclosed to others.

words.ex: The people showed resistance against the unfair law.
words.ex_cn: 人们对这项不公平的法律表示抵抗。
words.en: Resistance is the refusal to accept or comply with something; the attempt to prevent something by action or argument.

words.ex: The goal is attainable if you work hard.
words.ex_cn: 如果你努力工作，这个目标是可以达到的。
words.en: If something is attainable, it is possible to achieve it.

words.ex: Water is indispensable for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必不可少的。
words.en: Absolutely necessary or essential.

words.ex: Italian cuisine is famous for pasta and pizza.
words.ex_cn: 意大利烹调风格以意大利面和披萨闻名。
words.en: A style or method of cooking, especially as characteristic of a particular country, region, or establishment.

words.tr: adj. 有声望的；声誉好的
words.ex: He works for a reputable company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家信誉良好的公司工作。
words.en: A reputable person or organization is considered to be good and trustworthy by most people.

words.ex: His talent overshadowed his brother's achievements.
words.ex_cn: 他的才华使他兄弟的成就黯然失色。
words.en: If an unpleasant event or feeling overshadows something, it makes it less happy or enjoyable.

words.ex: Her talent is unparalleled.
words.ex_cn: 她的才华是无比的。
words.en: Having no parallel or equal; unmatched.

words.ex: The palace showed opulence with golden walls and silk curtains.
words.ex_cn: 宫殿以金墙和丝绸窗帘展现了富裕。
words.en: Opulence is great wealth or luxuriousness.

words.ex: The new law will supersede the old one.
words.ex_cn: 新法律将取代旧法律。
words.en: If something is superseded by something newer, it is replaced because it has become old-fashioned or unacceptable.

words.ex: The exploitation of natural resources helps the economy grow.
words.ex_cn: 自然资源的开发有助于经济发展。
words.en: The action or fact of treating someone unfairly in order to benefit from their work, or the utilization of something for profit or gain.

words.tr: adj. 热情的；充满热情的；
words.ex: She is passionate about teaching children.
words.ex_cn: 她对教孩子充满热情。
words.en: Having, showing, or caused by strong feelings or beliefs.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.tr:
n. 长条；条状；
v. 剥去；剥夺；
words.ex: He cut a strip of paper to wrap the gift.
words.ex_cn: 他剪了一条纸来包装礼物。
words.en: To remove a layer from something, or to take off your clothes.

words.tr:
v. 耗尽；用完；使筋疲力尽
n. 排气管；废气
words.ex: The long hike exhausted him.
words.ex_cn: 这次漫长的徒步旅行让他筋疲力尽。
words.en: If something exhausts you, it makes you so tired, either physically or mentally, that you have no energy left.

words.ex: The mysterious box appeared on his doorstep.
words.ex_cn: 那个神秘的盒子出现在他的门口。
words.en: If someone or something is mysterious, it is not fully understood or explained and seems interesting or puzzling.

words.ex: He did it out of spite.
words.ex_cn: 他出于恶意做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something out of spite, you do it because you want to hurt or upset someone.

words.ex: He showed his passport at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的护照。
words.en: A passport is an official document that identifies you as a citizen of a particular country and gives you the right to travel to and from that country.

words.ex: The road was diverted around the park.
words.ex_cn: 这条路被改道绕过公园。
words.en: If you divert someone or something, you cause them to change direction or to go somewhere different.

words.ex: The dissemination of information helps people learn.
words.ex_cn: 信息的传播帮助人们学习。
words.en: The act of spreading something, especially information, widely.

words.ex: The machine makes a perpetual noise.
words.ex_cn: 这台机器发出持续的噪音。
words.en: Something that is perpetual continues indefinitely or for a very long time without interruption.

words.ex: He contradicts what she said.
words.ex_cn: 他反驳了她的话。
words.en: If you contradict someone, you say that what they have just said is wrong, or you suggest that it is wrong by saying something different.

words.ex: She will organize a meeting tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 她明天将安排一次会议。
words.en: To organize something means to arrange it in a systematic way, especially on a large scale.

words.ex: The ancient temple has a tall stone column.
words.ex_cn: 这座古庙有一根高大的石柱。
words.en: A column is a tall solid upright stone post used to support a building or as a monument.

words.tr: n. 来源；出处；源泉；源头；提供资料者；
words.ex: The river's source is in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 这条河的源头在山里。
words.en: The place, person, or thing from which something comes or can be obtained.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅满足素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater means to provide food and drink at an event, often as a business service, or to provide what is needed or wanted by a particular person or group.

words.ex: We waited in the hotel lobby for our friend.
words.ex_cn: 我们在酒店的大厅里等我们的朋友。
words.en: A lobby is a large room or hall in a building, often used for meetings or as a waiting area. As a verb, to lobby means to try to influence politicians or officials on a particular issue.

words.ex: She is flexible with her schedule.
words.ex_cn: 她的日程安排很灵活。
words.en: Able to change or be changed easily according to the situation.

words.ex: He got a penalty for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因违反规则而受到惩罚。
words.en: A penalty is a punishment that is imposed on someone for doing something that is against the rules or the law.

words.ex: You must comply with the rules.
words.ex_cn: 你必须遵守规则。
words.en: To act in accordance with a wish or command.

words.tr: n. 网球拍；喧闹；非法勾当；
words.ex: He bought a new racket for tennis.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一副新的网球拍。
words.en: A racket is a piece of equipment used in sports such as tennis or badminton, consisting of a handle and a round or oval frame with a network of strings stretched across it. It can also refer to a loud, unpleasant noise or a dishonest or fraudulent scheme.

words.ex: He used a thin wire to fix the broken hook.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根细金属丝固定了坏掉的钩子。
words.en: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

words.ex: He took a capsule for his headache.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一粒胶囊来缓解头痛。
words.en: A capsule is a small container or case, especially one that is sealed and contains a dose of medicine, or a spacecraft's compartment for astronauts.

words.ex: He buys lunch in the school canteen.
words.ex_cn: 他在学校食堂买午餐。
words.en: A canteen is a place in a factory, office, or school where meals are served, often at a lower cost than in restaurants. It can also refer to a small container for carrying water or other drinks.

words.ex: He loves studying aeronautics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在大学里学习航空学。
words.en: The science or practice of travel through the air.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.tr:
n. 租契；
v. 出租；
words.ex: He signed a lease for the apartment.
words.ex_cn: 他签了公寓的租契。
words.en: A lease is a legal agreement by which the owner of a building, a piece of land, or something such as a car allows someone else to use it for a period of time in return for money.

words.tr: n. 少许；小块；片刻； v. “bite”的过去式；
words.ex: Can you give me a bit of sugar?
words.ex_cn: 你能给我一点点糖吗？
words.en: A bit is a small piece or quantity of something.

words.ex: He tried to conceal the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他试图隐藏真相。
words.en: If you conceal something, you prevent it from being seen or known about.

words.tr:
n. 妥协；
v. 危及；
words.ex: They reached a compromise after hours of talk.
words.ex_cn: 经过数小时的讨论，他们达成了妥协。
words.en: A compromise is an agreement between two people or groups in which each side gives up some of the things they want so that both sides are happy at the end.

words.ex: He arranged the books in a haphazard way.
words.ex_cn: 他随意地摆放了书。
words.en: If you describe something as haphazard, you are critical of it because it is not at all organized or is not arranged according to a plan.

words.tr: adj. 必需的；基本的；本质的；
words.ex: Water is essential for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命是必需的。
words.en: Something that is essential is extremely important or absolutely necessary to a particular subject, situation, or activity.

words.tr:
v. 力劝；
n. 强烈欲望；
words.ex: My teacher urged me to study harder.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师力劝我更加努力学习。
words.en: If you urge someone to do something, you try hard to persuade them to do it.

words.ex: It is feasible to finish the project in one week.
words.ex_cn: 一周内完成这个项目是可行的。
words.en: If something is feasible, it can be done, made, or achieved.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.ex: The existence of life on other planets is still unknown.
words.ex_cn: 其他星球上是否存在生命仍不清楚。
words.en: The state or fact of existing; being.

words.ex: He wants to apply for a job at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他想申请银行的工作。
words.en: To make a formal request, usually in writing, for something such as a job, a place at a university, or permission to do something.

words.ex: The workers cleaned the slurry from the construction site.
words.ex_cn: 工人们清理了建筑工地上的泥浆。
words.en: A slurry is a thin mixture of a liquid, especially water, and any of several finely divided substances, such as cement, plaster of Paris, or clay particles.

words.ex: The ticket is your admission to the concert.
words.ex_cn: 这张票是进入音乐会的许可。
words.en: An admission is a statement in which you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, or the act of allowing someone to enter a place or organization.

words.tr:
n. 企图；试图；
v. 企图；试图；
words.ex: His attempt to cheat on the test failed.
words.ex_cn: 他企图在考试中作弊，但失败了。
words.en: To make an effort to achieve or complete something, especially something difficult.

words.ex: He hurt his jaw when he fell.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒时伤到了下巴。
words.en: The jaw is the part of your face below your mouth that moves when you eat or speak.

words.ex: From the clues, he made a logical inference.
words.ex_cn: 从线索中，他做出了一个合理的推论。
words.en: An inference is a conclusion that you draw about something by using information that you already have about it.

words.ex: He drew a loop with the pencil.
words.ex_cn: 他用铅笔画了一个圈。
words.en: A loop is a shape produced by a curve that bends round and crosses itself, or a piece of wire, string, etc. that has this shape. It can also refer to a repeated sequence of operations or events in a computer program or in a process.

words.ex: Subtract 5 from 10 to get 5.
words.ex_cn: 从10中减去5得到5。
words.en: If you subtract one number from another, you take the first number away from the second.

words.ex: He is interested in linguistic patterns in children.
words.ex_cn: 他对儿童的语言模式感兴趣。
words.en: Relating to language or linguistics.

words.ex: He has a natural aptitude for math.
words.ex_cn: 他天生有数学天赋。
words.en: An aptitude is a natural ability to do something.

words.ex: The volcano spilled hot lava down the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 火山喷出炽热的岩浆流下山。
words.en: Lava is the molten rock that comes out of a volcano during an eruption.

words.ex: He is the premier player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 他是队里最优秀的球员。
words.en: The premier is the leader of the government in some countries, equivalent to a prime minister.

words.ex: The police opened an enquiry into the accident.
words.ex_cn: 警方对这起事故展开了调查。
words.en: An enquiry is a question you ask in order to get some information.

words.ex: He filed a lawsuit against the company.
words.ex_cn: 他向这家公司提起了诉讼。
words.en: A lawsuit is a case in a court of law which concerns a dispute between two people or organizations.

words.tr:
v. 包装；收拾行李；
n. 包裹；小包；
words.ex: She packs the gift in colorful paper.
words.ex_cn: 她用彩纸包装礼物。
words.en: A pack is a container of a particular kind, especially one made of strong paper or plastic and containing a number of the same items. As a verb, pack means to put something into a container, especially in a neat and efficient way.

words.ex: The doctor prescribed medicine for my cold.
words.ex_cn: 医生给我开了治疗感冒的药。
words.en: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

words.ex: The universe is very big.
words.ex_cn: 宇宙非常大。
words.en: The universe is the whole of space and everything in it, including stars, planets, and galaxies.

words.ex: The skull protects the brain.
words.ex_cn: 颅骨保护大脑。
words.en: The bony framework of the head that encloses the brain and supports the structures of the face.

words.ex: The empire's domination over the region lasted for centuries.
words.ex_cn: 这个帝国对该地区的统治持续了几个世纪。
words.en: The exercise of control or influence over someone or something, or the state of being so controlled.

words.tr:
adj. 有生命的；有活力的
v. 使具活力；做成动画
words.ex: The cartoon characters are animate and full of energy.
words.ex_cn: 这些卡通角色是有生命的，充满活力。
words.en: To animate something means to give it life or to make it lively and energetic.

words.tr: n. 会计工作；会计职业；
words.ex: He works in accountancy for a big company.
words.ex_cn: 他在一家大公司从事会计工作。
words.en: Accountancy is the theory or practice of keeping and inspecting financial accounts.

words.ex: The availability of free Wi-Fi is important for travelers.
words.ex_cn: 免费Wi-Fi的可用性对旅行者很重要。
words.en: The quality of being able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The bill is payable next week.
words.ex_cn: 这笔账单下周应付。
words.en: If an amount of money is payable, it has to be paid or it can be paid.

words.ex: He hired a solicitor to help with his house sale.
words.ex_cn: 他聘请了一名事务律师来帮助处理他的房屋出售。
words.en: A solicitor is a lawyer who gives legal advice and prepares legal documents, especially in England.

words.ex: The departure of the train was at 8 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 火车的出发时间是晚上8点。
words.en: The act of leaving a place, especially at the start of a journey.

words.ex: The company hired an expert to do an audit.
words.ex_cn: 公司聘请了一位专家进行审计。
words.en: An audit is an official examination of the accounts of a business or organization to check that they are accurate and correct.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.ex: The mice scamper away when they see the cat.
words.ex_cn: 老鼠一看到猫就四处奔逃。
words.en: If people or small animals scamper somewhere, they move there quickly with small, light steps.

words.tr:
n. 螺旋形；陡升或骤降；
v. 螺旋式上升（或下降）；
adj. 螺旋形的；
words.ex: The snail moved along a spiral path.
words.ex_cn: 蜗牛沿着一个螺旋形的路径爬行。
words.en: A spiral is a shape which winds round and round, with each curve above or outside the previous one.

words.ex: He will encode the message with a secret code.
words.ex_cn: 他将用密钥对这条信息进行编码。
words.en: To convert information into a particular form, especially for the purposes of secrecy or transmission.

words.tr:
n. 侦察兵；
v. 搜寻；
words.ex: The scout watched the enemy's movement quietly.
words.ex_cn: 侦察兵悄悄观察敌人的动向。
words.en: A scout is someone who is sent to an area of countryside to find out the position of an enemy or to search for a suitable place for a military camp.

words.tr: v. 反胃；回吐；依样复述
words.ex: He felt sick and began to regurgitate after eating the spoiled food.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了变质的食物后感到恶心，开始反胃。
words.en: To bring up and expel (food) from the stomach to the mouth, as in some birds feeding their young; to repeat (information) without understanding or thought.

words.tr: n. 推进剂；发射药；火箭燃料
words.ex: The rocket uses a strong propellant to fly.
words.ex_cn: 火箭使用一种强大的推进剂来飞行。
words.en: A propellant is a substance that is used to move something forward, especially a rocket or a bullet, by creating a force that pushes it.

words.ex: He felt sad after the rejection.
words.ex_cn: 在遭到拒绝后，他感到很难过。
words.en: The act of refusing to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

words.tr: n. 弹幕射击；掩护炮火；拦河坝
words.ex: The soldiers faced a barrage of bullets.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们面对着一阵弹雨。
words.en: A barrage is a heavy and continuous bombardment of gunfire or a dam built across a river to control the flow of water.

words.tr:
v. 密谋；激起…的兴趣
n. 阴谋诡计；密谋策划
words.ex: They intrigue to take over the company.
words.ex_cn: 他们密谋接管这家公司。
words.en: If something intrigues you, it interests you a lot because it seems strange or mysterious.

words.ex: The transition from school to work was hard for him.
words.ex_cn: 从学校到工作的转变对他来说很难。
words.en: The process or a period of changing from one state or condition to another.

words.ex: This book is about the realm of artificial intelligence.
words.ex_cn: 这本书是关于人工智能领域的。
words.en: A realm is a country ruled by a king or queen, or an area of activity, interest, or knowledge.

words.ex: Sugar is an ingredient in this cake.
words.ex_cn: 糖是这个蛋糕的一个成分。
words.en: An ingredient is one of the substances that are combined to make something, especially in cooking.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.ex: The astronaut walked on the moon.
words.ex_cn: 这名宇航员在月球上行走。
words.en: An astronaut is a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft.

words.ex: He waved a red banner in the parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在游行中挥舞着一面红旗子。
words.en: A banner is a long strip of cloth with a message or design on it, used especially for advertising or as a symbol of a particular group or cause.

words.ex: He added an ounce of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: An ounce is a unit of weight used in Britain and the USA. There are sixteen ounces in a pound.

words.ex: He learned a new technique to paint better.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一种新的绘画技术。
words.en: A technique is a particular method of doing an activity, usually a method that involves practical skills.

words.tr:
n. 一摞；一叠；一堆；大烟囱；
v. 把…放成整齐的一摞；
words.ex: He put the books in a stack on the table.
words.ex_cn: 他把书堆成一摞放在桌子上。
words.en: A stack is a pile of things, usually arranged one on top of another.

words.ex: He buys petrol every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五买汽油。
words.en: A liquid obtained from petroleum, used especially as a fuel in cars.

words.ex: He squeezed into the small seat.
words.ex_cn: 他挤进了小座位里。
words.en: To squeeze something means to press it firmly, usually with your fingers or hands, often to get liquid out of it or to make it smaller.

words.ex: He felt deep sorrow when his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗去世时，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Sorrow is a feeling of deep sadness or regret.

words.ex: The arboreal squirrel climbs high in the trees.
words.ex_cn: 这种树栖松鼠在高高的树上攀爬。
words.en: Relating to trees; living in trees.

words.ex: The old building has a beautiful facade with stone pillars.
words.ex_cn: 这栋老建筑有一个带有石柱的漂亮正面。
words.en: The front of a building, especially an imposing or decorative one. Also, a superficial appearance or illusion of something.

words.tr:
n. 验尸；尸检；事后调查
adj. 死后的；死后发生的
words.ex: The doctor did a postmortem to find the cause of death.
words.ex_cn: 医生做了尸检以查明死因。
words.en: An examination of a dead body to determine the cause of death or the character and extent of changes produced by disease.

words.tr: n. 不再抱幻想；幻想破灭
words.ex: He felt disillusionment when the truth came out.
words.ex_cn: 当真相揭露时，他感到幻灭。
words.en: Disillusionment is a feeling of disappointment resulting from the discovery that something is not as good as one believed it to be.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.tr:
adj. 不锋利的；耿直的
v. 使变钝
words.ex: The knife is blunt and cannot cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀不锋利，切不动纸。
words.en: If you are blunt, you say exactly what you think without trying to be polite.

words.tr:
n. 大量贮备；囤积
v. 大量储备；囤积
words.ex: The government built a stockpile of food for emergencies.
words.ex_cn: 政府为紧急情况储备了大量食物。
words.en: A stockpile is a large supply of something that is kept to be used in the future.

words.ex: The dark clouds indicate rain.
words.ex_cn: 乌云表明要下雨了。
words.en: If one thing indicates another, the first thing shows that the second is true or exists.

words.ex: The results were statistically significant.
words.ex_cn: 这些结果在统计上是显著的。
words.en: In a way that relates to statistics or the use of statistics.

words.tr:
v. 转换；
n. 开关；
words.ex: He switched off the light before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前把灯关掉了。
words.en: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

words.ex: There is uncertainty about the weather tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 明天的天气还不确定。
words.en: Uncertainty is a situation in which something is not known, or something that is not known or certain.

words.ex: He made a hypothesis that plants grow faster in light.
words.ex_cn: 他提出一个假设，认为植物在光照下长得更快。
words.en: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.

words.ex: The lab is ultraclean to prevent contamination.
words.ex_cn: 实验室非常洁净，以防止污染。
words.en: Extremely clean; free from dirt, impurities, or pollutants.

words.ex: The mountainous region has many hiking trails.
words.ex_cn: 这个多山的地区有许多徒步小径。
words.en: A mountainous area has a lot of mountains.

words.ex: He always keeps his garden trim and neat.
words.ex_cn: 他总是把花园打理得整洁有序。
words.en: To trim something means to make it tidier or more level by cutting a small amount off it.

words.tr:
adj. 稳定的；
v. 使稳住；
words.ex: The boat moved in a steady way on the calm sea.
words.ex_cn: 船在平静的海面上平稳地移动。
words.en: If something is steady, it is firm and does not shake or move about. If you steady something, you stop it from shaking or moving about.

words.ex: All new students must attend the orientation meeting on Monday.
words.ex_cn: 所有新生必须参加周一的新生报到会。
words.en: An orientation meeting is a gathering designed to introduce new members, employees, or students to an organization or institution, providing them with essential information and helping them to adapt to their new environment.

words.tr: adj. 急剧的；引人注目的；戏剧（性）的；
words.ex: There was a dramatic increase in temperature yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天温度急剧上升。
words.en: If something is dramatic, it happens or changes suddenly and noticeably.

words.tr: adj. 无定形的；无组织的；
words.ex: The glass is amorphous because it lacks a regular shape.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃是无定形的，因为它没有规则的形状。
words.en: Lacking a clear shape or form; not clearly defined or structured.

words.ex: He solved the math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快解决了这道数学题。
words.en: If you solve a problem or a question, you find a solution or an answer to it.

words.ex: The wind turns the blade of the fan.
words.ex_cn: 风转动了风扇的叶片。
words.en: The flat cutting part of a tool or weapon, such as a knife or sword.

words.ex: I caught a glimpse of the cat before it ran away.
words.ex_cn: 我在它跑掉之前瞥了一眼那只猫。
words.en: A glimpse is a brief, quick look at something or someone.

words.tr: n. 公告；布告；公报；新闻简报；
words.ex: The school posted a bulletin about the holiday schedule.
words.ex_cn: 学校张贴了一份关于假期安排的公告。
words.en: A bulletin is a short news report on the radio or television. A bulletin is also a short printed newspaper or leaflet that gives information about a particular group or organization.

words.ex: The loud music annoys me.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我烦恼。
words.en: If someone or something annoys you, it makes you fairly angry and impatient.

words.ex: He walks to the chapel every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期天都去小教堂。
words.en: A chapel is a small building or room used for Christian worship, typically one that is not a parish church.

words.tr: v. 捐赠；订阅；订购；签署；认购（股份）
words.ex: He decided to subscribe $50 to the charity each month.
words.ex_cn: 他决定每月向慈善机构捐赠50美元。
words.en: If you subscribe to a magazine or a service, you pay to receive it regularly.

words.tr:
n. 箔；陪衬物
v. 阻止；挫败
words.ex: He used foil to wrap the sandwich.
words.ex_cn: 他用锡纸包住了三明治。
words.en: To prevent someone from succeeding in their plans or intentions, especially by doing something clever or unexpected.

words.tr:
n. 发票；发货单；
v. 开发票；记清单；
words.ex: He paid the bill after receiving the invoice.
words.ex_cn: 他收到发票后付了款。
words.en: An invoice is a document that lists goods or services that have been provided and says how much money you owe for them.

words.tr:
adj. 额外的；
n. 额外的事物；
adv. 额外地；
words.ex: He did extra work to earn more money.
words.ex_cn: 他做了额外的工作来赚更多的钱。
words.en: If something is extra, it is added to an existing amount or number.

words.ex: The wizard can transmute lead into gold.
words.ex_cn: 巫师可以把铅变成金子。
words.en: To change something completely, especially into something different and better.

words.ex: He analyzes data every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天分析数据。
words.en: To examine something methodically and in detail, typically in order to explain and interpret it.

words.ex: The room has good acoustic properties.
words.ex_cn: 这个房间有良好的声音效果。
words.en: Relating to sound or the sense of hearing.

words.tr:
n. 摊位；
v. 故意拖延；
words.ex: He sells fruits at a stall in the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场的一个摊位上卖水果。
words.en: A stall is a small open-fronted shop or a compartment for one animal in a stable or barn. As a verb, it means to stop or cause to stop making progress.

words.tr:
v. 包括；遮盖；报道；
n. 遮盖物；庇护所；封面；
words.ex: The book covers basic math and science.
words.ex_cn: 这本书包括基础数学和科学。
words.en: If something covers something else, it has been placed over or upon it, usually in order to protect it or hide it.

words.ex: The scientist made a breakthrough in cancer research.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家在癌症研究中取得了突破。
words.en: A breakthrough is a significant development or achievement that helps to solve a problem or improve a situation.

words.tr: n. 微处理器；微处理机
words.ex: The computer has a fast microprocessor.
words.ex_cn: 这台电脑有一个快速的微处理器。
words.en: A microprocessor is a small chip that can process data and carry out instructions in a computer or other electronic device.

words.ex: He finds peace through spiritual meditation.
words.ex_cn: 他通过精神上的冥想找到平静。
words.en: Relating to the human spirit or soul as opposed to material or physical things.

words.tr:
n. 混凝土；
adj. 具体的；
words.ex: The workers poured concrete to build the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 工人们浇筑混凝土来建造地基。
words.en: Concrete is a hard, strong construction material made by mixing a cementing material (such as Portland cement) and a mineral aggregate (such as sand and gravel) with sufficient water to cause the cement to set and bind the entire mass. In a broader sense, concrete can also refer to something that is tangible, specific, or real.

words.tr: v. 概括；归纳；泛论；推广
words.ex: He tries to generalise from one example.
words.ex_cn: 他试图从一个例子中得出普遍结论。
words.en: If you generalise, you say something that seems to be true in most situations or for most people, but that may not be completely true in all cases.

words.tr: adj. 不同寻常的；非凡的；显著的；值得注意的；
words.ex: She made a remarkable improvement in just one month.
words.ex_cn: 她在短短一个月内取得了不同寻常的进步。
words.en: Unusual or striking in a way that attracts attention.

words.tr:
n. 凝块；泥团；密集的一群
v. 凝结成块
words.ex: The blood began to clot after the cut.
words.ex_cn: 伤口流血后开始凝固。
words.en: A clot is a sticky lump that forms when blood dries up or becomes thick. If blood clots, it becomes thick and forms a lump.

words.ex: Prior to the meeting, we reviewed the report.
words.ex_cn: 在会议之前，我们复习了报告。
words.en: Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.

words.ex: He tried to integrate into the new school community.
words.ex_cn: 他试图融入新的学校群体。
words.en: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

words.tr: v. 举例说明；例证；例示
words.ex: This example exemplifies the rule clearly.
words.ex_cn: 这个例子清楚地说明了这条规则。
words.en: To exemplify means to be a typical example of something or to give an example of something.

words.ex: The herdsman walks with his sheep every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牧人每天早上带着他的羊群散步。
words.en: A herdsman is a man who takes care of a herd of animals, especially cattle, sheep, or goats, as his job.

words.tr: n. 公式化；阐述方式；规划；配方
words.ex: The formulation of the equation took hours.
words.ex_cn: 这个公式的推导花了好几个小时。
words.en: The act or process of formulating something, especially a systematic statement of principles or a particular method of preparing something.

words.ex: He did an exploratory trip to find new places.
words.ex_cn: 他进行了一次探索性的旅行来寻找新地方。
words.en: relating to or involving exploration or investigation

words.ex: The cows graze in the pasture.
words.ex_cn: 牛在牧场上吃草。
words.en: Pasture is land covered with grass where animals such as cows and sheep can graze.

words.ex: Vegetables are rich in nutrient.
words.ex_cn: 蔬菜富含营养物。
words.en: A nutrient is a substance that is essential for life and growth, such as the vitamins and minerals in food.

words.tr:
n. 犁；犁形器具
v. 犁；耕；艰苦前进
words.ex: The farmer uses a plow to turn the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农夫用犁翻土。
words.en: A plow is a farm tool with one or more heavy blades that breaks the soil and cuts a furrow for sowing seeds.

words.ex: He waved a patriotic flag during the parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在游行中挥舞着一面爱国的旗帜。
words.en: If someone is patriotic, they feel love, loyalty, and respect for their country.

words.ex: The deer walked through the scrub near the hill.
words.ex_cn: 鹿穿过了山边的灌木丛。
words.en: To scrub something means to rub it hard in order to clean it, especially using a stiff brush and water.

words.ex: The visa application requires a lot of formality.
words.ex_cn: 签证申请需要很多正式手续。
words.en: A formality is something that is done as part of a formal process or procedure, often without much thought or feeling because it is expected.

words.ex: You need basic math as a prerequisite for this course.
words.ex_cn: 你学习这门课程的前提是掌握基础数学。
words.en: A prerequisite is something that must exist or happen before something else can exist or happen.

words.ex: The music heightens the feeling of sadness.
words.ex_cn: 音乐加深了悲伤的感觉。
words.en: If something heightens a feeling or if the feeling heightens, the feeling increases in degree or intensity.

words.ex: The immigrants quickly learned the language and culture, showing rapid assimilation.
words.ex_cn: 这些移民很快学会了语言和文化，显示出快速的同化。
words.en: The process of taking in and fully understanding information or ideas.

words.ex: Water is a basic necessity for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本必需品。
words.en: Something that is necessary or indispensable.

words.ex: He used a disposable cup for his coffee.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一次性杯子喝咖啡。
words.en: Something that is disposable is intended to be thrown away after use.

words.ex: His ingenuity solved the problem with a simple tool.
words.ex_cn: 他的独创力用一个简单的工具解决了问题。
words.en: Ingenuity is the ability to think of clever and original ways to solve problems.

words.ex: The simplicity of the design makes it easy to use.
words.ex_cn: 这种设计的简单使它容易使用。
words.en: The quality or condition of being easy to understand or do.

words.ex: The luxuriant forest had thick trees and deep green leaves.
words.ex_cn: 这片茂密的森林有茂盛的树木和深绿色的叶子。
words.en: Luxuriant is used to describe something that is rich in growth, abundance, or opulence.

words.ex: The decision was consequential for the future of the company.
words.ex_cn: 这个决定对公司未来意义重大。
words.en: Something that is consequential is important or significant, often because it has effects on other things.

words.ex: She scoured the pan until it was clean.
words.ex_cn: 她把锅擦得干干净净。
words.en: If you scour something, you clean it by rubbing it hard with something rough.

words.ex: The store sells seasonal fruits like strawberries in spring.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店在春天出售草莓等季节性水果。
words.en: Seasonal means relating to or happening during a particular season.

words.ex: The river water looked murky after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 雨后，河水看起来污浊。
words.en: If you describe something as murky, you mean that the details of it are not clear or that it is difficult to understand.

words.ex: He takes melatonin to sleep better at night.
words.ex_cn: 他服用褪黑素以更好地入睡。
words.en: A hormone secreted by the pineal gland that regulates sleep and wakefulness.

words.ex: The teacher gave a cue to start the game.
words.ex_cn: 老师给出了开始游戏的提示。
words.en: A cue is a signal for someone to do something, or a piece of information that helps someone to understand something.

words.ex: The thermal blanket keeps you warm.
words.ex_cn: 这个保暖毯让你暖和。
words.en: relating to heat or temperature

words.ex: The French Revolution changed the government.
words.ex_cn: 法国大革命改变了政府。
words.en: A revolution is a sudden, extreme, or complete change in something, or the act of making such a change.

words.tr: phrase. 身份证；“identity card”的缩写
words.ex: He showed his id card at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他在机场出示了他的身份证。
words.en: An ID card is a card with a person's name, photograph, date of birth, and other information on it, which proves who they are.

words.ex: They wrote a love letter every day, and it became their romance.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天写一封情书，这成为了他们的浪漫史。
words.en: Romance refers to the feelings and behaviors characteristic of love, especially in its early stages, or a story, movie, or other work dealing with love in a sentimental or idealized way.

words.ex: She is currently working at a hospital.
words.ex_cn: 她目前正在一家医院工作。
words.en: at the present time

words.ex: He uses inferential statistics to predict the result.
words.ex_cn: 他使用推断统计来预测结果。
words.en: Inferential means relating to or involving inference, which is the process of deriving logical conclusions from premises known or assumed to be true.

words.ex: The rain persisted all day.
words.ex_cn: 雨持续了一整天。
words.en: If you persist in doing something, you continue to do it even though it is difficult or other people are against it.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.tr:
v. 藏匿；隐藏
n. 一批贮藏物
words.ex: He stashes his money under the bed.
words.ex_cn: 他把钱藏在床底下。
words.en: If you stash something valuable in a secret place, you store it there to keep it safe.

words.ex: This forest has many different species of birds.
words.ex_cn: 这片森林有多种不同的鸟类物种。
words.en: A species is a class of plants or animals whose members have the same main characteristics and are able to breed with each other.

words.ex: The difference between the two colors is subtle.
words.ex_cn: 这两种颜色之间的区别很微妙。
words.en: Something that is subtle is not immediately obvious or noticeable, but is rather indirect or understated.

words.ex: He is a competent teacher who helps students easily.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有能力的老师，能轻松帮助学生。
words.en: If you are competent to do something, you have the skills, abilities, or experience necessary to do it well.

words.tr:
v. 选择；挑选；
adj. 精心挑选的；
words.ex: He will select the best candidate for the job.
words.ex_cn: 他将选择最适合这份工作的人。
words.en: If you select something, you choose it from a number of things of the same kind.

words.tr: adj. 未固定牢的；宽松的；
words.ex: The loose screw fell off the table.
words.ex_cn: 那个松动的螺丝从桌子上掉了下来。
words.en: Not firmly or tightly fixed in place; detached or able to be detached.

words.tr: adj. 可获得的；有空的；可用的；
words.ex: The books are available in the library.
words.ex_cn: 这些书在图书馆里可以借到。
words.en: If something is available, it is able to be used or obtained.

words.ex: The story includes an illustration of kindness.
words.ex_cn: 这个故事包含了一个善良的例证。
words.en: An illustration is a picture or diagram that helps make something clear or attractive.

words.tr: n. 切片；薄片；部分；片段；
words.ex: She ate a slice of bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一片面包。
words.en: A slice of something is a thin piece or portion of it.

words.ex: They walked along the waterfront and enjoyed the view.
words.ex_cn: 他们沿着滨水区散步，欣赏景色。
words.en: The part of a town or city that is next to a river, lake, or the sea, especially the part where there are docks and where ships load and unload.

words.ex: He bought a generic brand of painkiller.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一种普通的止痛药品牌。
words.en: Generic refers to something that is not specific or unique, often used to describe products that are not branded or are general in nature.

words.ex: He plays cricket every weekend with his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他每个周末都和朋友们打板球。
words.en: Cricket is a sport played between two teams of eleven players each, using a bat and ball, on a field with a wicket at each end.

words.ex: He exhale slowly after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后慢慢呼出气。
words.en: To exhale means to breathe out air from your lungs.

words.ex: The painting is a beautiful creation of the artist.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画是艺术家的一个美丽作品。
words.en: The act or process of bringing something into existence.

words.ex: The corporate office is in New York.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司的总部在纽约。
words.en: Corporate relates to large companies or to a particular large company.

words.ex: The wound began to swell after the insect bite.
words.ex_cn: 被昆虫叮咬后，伤口开始肿胀。
words.en: To increase in size or volume as a result of internal pressure; to expand.

words.ex: The synthesis of ideas helped solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 这些想法的综合帮助解决了问题。
words.en: The act of combining different ideas, influences, or objects into a new and coherent whole.

words.ex: The dog left its excreta on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 狗在草地上留下了排泄物。
words.en: Waste matter discharged from the body, especially feces and urine.

words.ex: The villain tried to decapitate the hero with a sword.
words.ex_cn: 反派试图用剑砍下英雄的头。
words.en: To decapitate someone means to cut off their head.

words.ex: She added pepper to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 她往汤里加了胡椒粉。
words.en: Pepper is a hot-tasting powder made from the crushed seeds of certain plants, used to flavor food.

words.tr:
v. 呻吟；叹息
n. 呻吟声；叹息声
words.ex: He groaned when he saw the heavy box.
words.ex_cn: 他看到那个沉重的箱子时呻吟了一声。
words.en: If you groan, you make a long, low sound because you are in pain, or because you are upset or unhappy about something.

words.ex: The noise will diminish after midnight.
words.ex_cn: 午夜后噪音会减少。
words.en: If something diminishes, or if something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

words.ex: The child gave a naive smile when he believed the story.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子相信这个故事时，他露出了天真的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as naïve, you think they lack experience and so expect things to be easy or people to be honest or kind.

words.tr:
adj. 难过的；沮丧的；
v. 打乱；使心烦；
words.ex: He felt upset when his dog ran away.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗跑掉时，他感到很难过。
words.en: If you are upset, you are unhappy or disappointed because something unpleasant has happened to you.

words.tr:
n. 吸引力；上诉；
v. 吸引；诉请；呼吁；
words.ex: The appeal of the beach drew many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 海滩的吸引力吸引了许多游客。
words.en: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them. If you appeal against a decision or sentence, you formally ask a court or other authority to change it. If something appeals to you, you like it or it interests you.

words.ex: The consumption of water has increased this year.
words.ex_cn: 今年水的消耗量增加了。
words.en: Consumption is the act of buying and using products.

words.tr:
n. 小心；警告；注意；
v. 警告；劝...小心；
words.ex: He drove with caution on the icy road.
words.ex_cn: 他在结冰的道路上小心驾驶。
words.en: Caution is care that you take in order to avoid possible danger or trouble.

words.tr:
n. 平均数；平均水平；
adj. 平均的；普通的；
v. 平均为…；
words.ex: The average of 4, 5, and 6 is 5.
words.ex_cn: 4、5和6的平均数是5。
words.en: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

words.tr:
adj. 浅色头发的；金色的；白皙的
n. 金发女郎
words.ex: The blonde girl is singing in the park.
words.ex_cn: 那个金发女孩正在公园里唱歌。
words.en: A blonde person has hair that is pale gold in color.

words.tr:
v. 爆裂；突然而起；
n. 爆裂；突然而起；
words.ex: The balloon burst when he blew too much air.
words.ex_cn: 当他吹入太多空气时，气球爆裂了。
words.en: If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out; used especially to describe the sound of something breaking open.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.ex: His profession is a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他的职业是教师。
words.en: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

words.ex: I like fruits, for instance, apples and bananas.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢水果，例如苹果和香蕉。
words.en: Used to introduce an example that illustrates or supports a point being made.

words.ex: The transit of goods takes three days.
words.ex_cn: 货物的运输需要三天。
words.en: The act or process of passing through or across; the conveyance of people or goods from one place to another.

words.ex: The castle is a medieval building.
words.ex_cn: 这座城堡是一座中世纪的建筑。
words.en: Relating to the Middle Ages, the period in European history from about the 5th century to the 15th century.

words.ex: The child behaves well in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子在课堂上表现得很好。
words.en: To behave means to act in a particular way, especially in a way that is good or correct.

words.tr: adj. 毁灭性的； v. “devastate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The earthquake caused devastating damage to the city.
words.ex_cn: 地震对这座城市造成了毁灭性的破坏。
words.en: If you describe something as devastating, you are emphasizing that it is very harmful or damaging.

words.tr:
v. 疏浚；挖掘
n. 挖泥船；疏浚机
words.ex: They dredge the river to remove mud.
words.ex_cn: 他们疏浚河流以清除淤泥。
words.en: To dredge means to remove mud, sand, or other material from the bottom of a river, lake, etc., in order to make it deeper or to search for something.

words.tr:
v. 发射；发起；启动；
n. 发射；投掷；启动；
words.ex: They will launch a rocket tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将发射一枚火箭。
words.en: To launch something means to send it into the air, space, or water, especially with a lot of force or effort, or to start an activity, event, or project.

words.ex: The old bridge will disintegrate if no one fixes it.
words.ex_cn: 如果没人修理，这座旧桥会瓦解。
words.en: If something disintegrates, it breaks into many small pieces or parts and is destroyed.

words.ex: The colors of the painting fade in the sunlight.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画的颜色在阳光下逐渐消失。
words.en: To gradually grow faint and disappear.

words.ex: The car drove fast on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 汽车在高速公路上开得很快。
words.en: A highway is a main road, especially one that connects towns or cities.

words.ex: He finally conceded defeat after the match.
words.ex_cn: 比赛结束后，他终于承认失败了。
words.en: If you concede something, you admit, often unwillingly, that it is true or correct.

words.ex: The chef cooked a delicious dinner for the guests.
words.ex_cn: 主厨为客人做了一顿美味的晚餐。
words.en: A chef is a professional cook, typically the chief cook in a restaurant or hotel.

words.ex: He filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.ex_cn: 他投诉了吵闹的邻居。
words.en: A complaint is a statement in which you express your dissatisfaction with a particular situation.

words.ex: He is irritable when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 他累了的时候容易烦躁。
words.en: If someone is irritable, they are easily annoyed.

words.ex: The new legislation bans plastic bags.
words.ex_cn: 这项新法规禁止使用塑料袋。
words.en: Legislation refers to the process of making or enacting laws by a government or other authority.

words.ex: The ball is bouncing on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 球正在地板上弹跳。
words.en: If someone is bouncing, they are full of energy and enthusiasm.

words.ex: He earned a sizeable amount of money from his business.
words.ex_cn: 他从生意中赚了一笔可观的钱。
words.en: A sizeable amount or quantity of something is fairly large.

words.tr: adj. 革新的；富有革新精神的；
words.ex: The company made an innovative phone.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司推出了一款革新的手机。
words.en: Something that is innovative is new and original, especially in the way that it is done.

words.ex: Traffic congestion caused delays on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 交通堵塞导致了高速公路的延误。
words.en: Congestion refers to the state of being overcrowded, especially with traffic or people, or the condition of being blocked or clogged.

words.tr:
adj. 粒子状的；微粒的
n. 粒子；微粒状物质
words.ex: The air contains particulate matter from smoke.
words.ex_cn: 空气中含有来自烟雾的粒子状物质。
words.en: Relating to or in the form of minute separate particles.

words.ex: The factory releases a pollutant into the river.
words.ex_cn: 工厂向河里排放一种污染物。
words.en: A pollutant is a substance that pollutes something, especially air, water, or soil.

words.ex: A megacity has more than ten million people.
words.ex_cn: 一个大城市有超过一千万人。
words.en: A megacity is a very large city, typically one with a population of over ten million people.

words.ex: He is allergic to peanuts.
words.ex_cn: 他对花生过敏。
words.en: If you are allergic to something, you become ill or get a rash when you eat it, smell it, or touch it.

words.ex: The populace enjoyed the free concert in the park.
words.ex_cn: 平民们享受了公园里的免费音乐会。
words.en: The general public; the common people.

words.ex: The king proclaimed a new law.
words.ex_cn: 国王宣告了一项新法律。
words.en: If you proclaim something, you formally announce it or declare it publicly.

words.ex: The teacher gave supervision to the students during the exam.
words.ex_cn: 老师在考试期间监督学生。
words.en: The act of overseeing or directing a project, activity, or person.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.tr: adj. 惯常的；习惯性的；经常的；
words.ex: He is a habitual smoker.
words.ex_cn: 他是个惯常的吸烟者。
words.en: A habitual action, state, or way of behaving is one that someone usually does or has, especially one that is considered to be typical or characteristic of them.

words.tr: v. 恢复；修复；改造（罪犯）
words.ex: The hospital will rehabilitate the injured athlete.
words.ex_cn: 医院将帮助受伤的运动员康复。
words.en: To rehabilitate someone who has been ill or in prison means to help them to live a normal life again. To rehabilitate a building or an area means to improve its condition.

words.ex: The village by the lake is picturesque.
words.ex_cn: 湖边的村庄如画般美丽。
words.en: A picturesque place is attractive and interesting, especially in a way that is old-fashioned or unusual.

words.ex: The boys went afield to hunt birds.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们离家远去打猎。
words.en: If you go afield, you go a long way from home or from your usual surroundings.

words.tr:
n. 形式；表格；形状；
v. 组成；建立；
words.ex: The form of the poem is very simple.
words.ex_cn: 这首诗的形式非常简单。
words.en: A form is a particular way in which a thing exists or appears, or a document with spaces in which to write information.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.tr:
v. 溢出；溅出
n. 溢出；溅出
words.ex: He spilled milk on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶洒在了地上。
words.en: To cause or allow (a liquid, powder, etc.) to flow or fall out of a container, usually by accident.

words.ex: The movie was mediocre and not worth watching.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影很平庸，不值得看。
words.en: If you describe something as mediocre, you mean that it is of average quality but you think it should be better.

words.tr:
v. 引导；领导；带头；
n. 主导地位；铅；领先；
words.ex: The teacher leads the students to the library.
words.ex_cn: 老师带领学生去图书馆。
words.en: To be in charge of a group, country, or situation; to guide or direct in a course; a position of advantage in a contest or competition; a heavy, malleable, ductile, bluish-white, dense metallic element.

words.ex: The teacher define the word 'love' in simple terms.
words.ex_cn: 老师用简单的词给‘爱’下定义。
words.en: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

words.tr:
v. 弄懂；认为；
n. 数字；重要或有名的人物；
words.ex: I couldn't figure out why he was late.
words.ex_cn: 我弄不懂他为什么迟到。
words.en: A figure is a number, a person, a shape, or a form. It can also refer to the process of calculating or appearing in a particular way.

words.tr: adj. 富有成效的；多产的；生产的；
words.ex: He had a productive day and finished all his work.
words.ex_cn: 他度过了富有成效的一天，完成了所有工作。
words.en: Producing or able to produce large amounts of goods, crops, or other commodities.

words.ex: He responded to the question quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他很快回答了问题。
words.en: If you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

words.ex: The teacher gave her approval for the project.
words.ex_cn: 老师对这个项目表示了赞成。
words.en: If you give your approval to something, you agree with it or allow it to happen.

words.tr:
n. 闻；气味；嗅觉；
v. 嗅；闻；散发气味；察觉；
words.ex: The smell of fresh bread made me hungry.
words.ex_cn: 新鲜面包的香味让我饿了。
words.en: The faculty or power of perceiving odors or scents by means of the organs in the nose.

words.ex: The flaw in the glass made it break easily.
words.ex_cn: 玻璃上的瑕疵让它很容易碎。
words.en: A flaw is a mistake or weakness in something that makes it less effective or valuable.

words.ex: The store offers multiple flavors of ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店提供多种口味的冰淇淋。
words.en: If something is multiple, it consists of or involves many things of the same kind.

words.ex: He went on an adventure in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他去丛林里冒险。
words.en: An adventure is an exciting experience or undertaking that is typically bold, sometimes risky.

words.ex: This is a no-parking zone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个禁止停车的地带。
words.en: An area or a region distinguished from adjacent parts by a distinctive feature or characteristic.

words.ex: The teacher drew a diagram to explain the water cycle.
words.ex_cn: 老师画了一个图表来解释水循环。
words.en: A diagram is a simple drawing which consists mainly of lines and is used, for example, to explain how a machine works.

words.ex: The factory uses raw material to make plastic.
words.ex_cn: 工厂用原材料制造塑料。
words.en: Raw material refers to the basic material from which a product is made.

words.tr:
v. 没精打采地站（或坐、走）；低头垂肩地站（或坐、走）
n. 没精打采的样子
words.ex: He slouches in his chair while watching TV.
words.ex_cn: 他看电视时驼背坐着。
words.en: If someone slouches, they sit or stand with their shoulders and head bent so that they look lazy and tired.

words.ex: The roses are in bloom in spring.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰在春天开花。
words.en: When a plant or tree blooms, it produces flowers. The period during which a plant or tree produces flowers is also known as its bloom.

words.tr: n. 地平线；思想等的范围；眼界；
words.ex: The sun set below the horizon.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在地平线以下落山。
words.en: The horizon is the line at which the earth's surface and the sky appear to meet.

words.ex: He showed me the trick to solve this math problem quickly.
words.ex_cn: 他给我展示了快速解决这道数学题的诀窍。
words.en: A trick is a clever or deceitful action intended to deceive or outwit someone.

words.ex: The water freezes at zero centigrade.
words.ex_cn: 水在零摄氏度时结冰。
words.en: Centigrade is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.ex: The courageous firefighter saved the child from the burning house.
words.ex_cn: 这位勇敢的消防员从着火的房子里救出了孩子。
words.en: Someone who is courageous shows courage.

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as if he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something appears or behaves, suggesting that the appearance or behavior is not real or true

words.tr: phrase. 好像...似的； 仿佛...一样
words.ex: He talks as though he knows everything.
words.ex_cn: 他说话的样子好像什么都知道。
words.en: used to describe how someone or something seems to be, or how someone behaves, when this is not the real situation

words.tr:
adj. 学术的；
n. 大学教师；学者；
words.ex: He published an academic paper on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他发表了一篇关于气候变化的学术论文。
words.en: relating to education, especially at college or university level

words.tr: adj. 较合意的；更可取的；
words.ex: Tea is preferable to coffee in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早上喝茶比喝咖啡更合意。
words.en: If you say that one thing is preferable to another, you mean that it is more desirable or suitable.

words.ex: The phone uses biometrics to unlock.
words.ex_cn: 手机使用生物识别技术解锁。
words.en: Biometrics refers to the measurement and statistical analysis of people's unique physical and behavioral characteristics. The technology is mainly used for identification and access control or for identifying individuals who are under surveillance.

words.tr: v. 再结合；再统一；重聚
words.ex: The family will reunite next summer.
words.ex_cn: 这家人将在明年夏天重聚。
words.en: If people are reunited, or if someone reunites them, they meet each other again after they have been separated for some time.

words.ex: The minority group voted for change.
words.ex_cn: 少数群体投票支持变革。
words.en: A minority is a group of people within a community or country who are different from the majority of the people there in race, religion, or political beliefs.

words.tr:
v. 握紧；捏紧；咬牙切齿
n. 抓紧；咬紧；抓紧用具
words.ex: He clenched his fist when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个消息时握紧了拳头。
words.en: To close or hold something very tightly, especially in a determined or angry way.

words.ex: The linguist analyzed the English corpus to find common phrases.
words.ex_cn: 语言学家分析了英语语料库以寻找常用短语。
words.en: A corpus is a large collection of written or spoken texts that is used for language research.

words.tr:
n. 警报；闹钟；惊慌；
v. 使惊恐；
words.ex: The fire alarm rang loudly.
words.ex_cn: 火警警报大声响了起来。
words.en: An alarm is a warning of danger, often given by a bell or flashing light.

words.ex: The satellite beams signals to Earth.
words.ex_cn: 卫星向地球发射信号。
words.en: A beam is a long, thick piece of wood, metal, or concrete that is used to support the roof of a building. It can also refer to a line of light that shines from a bright object, or a smile that shows someone is very happy.

words.ex: The rain and the thunder happened in conjunction.
words.ex_cn: 雨和雷声同时发生。
words.en: A conjunction is a word that is used to connect clauses or sentences or to coordinate words in the same clause.

words.ex: The height of the tree is ten meters.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的高度是十米。
words.en: The measurement of someone or something from head to foot or from base to top.

words.tr: n. 自动扶梯；电动扶梯；
words.ex: He took the escalator to the second floor.
words.ex_cn: 他乘自动扶梯上了二楼。
words.en: An escalator is a moving staircase that carries people between floors of a building or structure.

words.ex: The weather today is nasty and rainy.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气令人不愉快，又阴又雨。
words.en: If you describe something as nasty, you mean it is very unpleasant, unattractive, or unkind.

words.ex: The old ship was a monster on the sea.
words.ex_cn: 那艘旧船在海上是个庞然大物。
words.en: A monster is an imaginary creature that is very large, ugly, and frightening.

words.ex: He continually checks his phone.
words.ex_cn: 他不停地查看手机。
words.en: If something happens continually, it happens without stopping or happening repeatedly over a period of time.

words.ex: The water supply is adequate for the village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对这个村庄来说是足够的。
words.en: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

words.tr:
n. 远足；
v. 远足；
words.ex: We went on a long hike in the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们去山里进行了一次长途远足。
words.en: A hike is a long walk in the country, especially one that you go on for pleasure. It can also refer to an increase in the cost or amount of something.

words.ex: I am grateful for your help.
words.ex_cn: 我感激你的帮助。
words.en: If you are grateful for something that someone has given you or done for you, you have warm, friendly feelings towards them and wish to thank them.

words.ex: The heart is an important organ in the body.
words.ex_cn: 心脏是身体中重要的器官。
words.en: An organ is a part of an organism that is typically self-contained and has a specific vital function, such as the heart or liver in humans.

words.ex: Children rely on their parents for food and shelter.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们依靠父母提供食物和住所。
words.en: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

words.ex: The bonus is an incentive to work harder.
words.ex_cn: 奖金是努力工作的动机。
words.en: Something that encourages a person to do something or to work harder.

words.ex: I need at least three apples to make a pie.
words.ex_cn: 我至少需要三个苹果来做派。
words.en: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

words.ex: He works in a technical department.
words.ex_cn: 他在一个技术部门工作。
words.en: Technical means involving the sorts of machines, processes, and materials that are used in industry, transport, and communications.

words.tr:
v. 合唱；异口同声地说
n. 合唱团；合唱
words.ex: They chorus when the song reaches the bridge.
words.ex_cn: 当歌曲进行到桥段时，他们一起合唱。
words.en: A chorus is a part of a song which is repeated after each verse, or a group of people who sing together.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.ex: Hitherto, no one has solved the problem.
words.ex_cn: 迄今为止，没有人解决过这个问题。
words.en: Until now or until the point in time under discussion.

words.ex: He worked hard to accomplish his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以实现自己的目标。
words.en: To accomplish something means to succeed in doing it, especially after a lot of effort.

words.ex: The soldier picked up a bullet from the ground.
words.ex_cn: 士兵从地上捡起一颗子弹。
words.en: A bullet is a small piece of metal with a pointed or rounded end, which is fired from a gun.

words.ex: He lives in a rural village with no big shops.
words.ex_cn: 他住在没有大商店的农村村庄里。
words.en: Rural areas are areas which are not towns or cities. They are often farming or agricultural areas.

words.ex: The cows graze in the enclosure.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛在围场里吃草。
words.en: An enclosure is an area that is surrounded by a barrier or fence, often used to keep animals in or to protect something.

words.ex: The company will discontinue the old model.
words.ex_cn: 公司将会停止生产这款旧型号。
words.en: If you discontinue something that you have been doing regularly, you stop doing it.

words.ex: The land will revegetate after the fire.
words.ex_cn: 火灾之后，这片土地会重新长出植被。
words.en: To revegetate means to plant new vegetation in an area where the vegetation has been lost or removed, often as part of environmental restoration efforts.

words.ex: We need sustainable energy to protect the environment.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要可持续的能源来保护环境。
words.en: If something is sustainable, it can be maintained or continued at a certain rate or level without causing damage or depletion of resources.

words.ex: The dispersal of seeds helps plants grow in new places.
words.ex_cn: 种子的分散有助于植物在新地方生长。
words.en: The act of spreading things or people over a wide area.

words.ex: The concert was fabulous!
words.ex_cn: 这场音乐会太棒了！
words.en: If you describe something as fabulous, you are emphasizing that you like it a lot or think that it is very good.

words.tr: n. 零售业； v. “retail”的现在分词；
words.ex: Retailing is a big part of the economy.
words.ex_cn: 零售业是经济的重要组成部分。
words.en: Retailing is the activity of selling goods to the public, usually in shops.

words.ex: The rental of the apartment costs $800 per month.
words.ex_cn: 这套公寓的租赁费用是每月800美元。
words.en: The act of paying for the use of something, such as property, a vehicle, or equipment, or the amount paid for such use.

words.tr: n. 痴迷；困扰；着魔；强迫观念；
words.ex: His obsession with video games made him ignore his studies.
words.ex_cn: 他对电子游戏的痴迷让他忽略了学业。
words.en: An obsession is an idea or thought that continually preoccupies or intrudes on a person's mind.

words.tr: adj. 充满（不愉快事物）的；
words.ex: The journey was fraught with delays.
words.ex_cn: 这次旅程充满了延误。
words.en: If a situation or activity is fraught with problems or risks, it is full of them.

words.tr: adj. 轻飘的；缥缈的；虚空的；精致的；
words.ex: The ethereal scarf floated gently in the wind.
words.ex_cn: 那条轻飘的围巾在风中轻轻飘动。
words.en: Something that is ethereal is extremely delicate and light in a way that seems not to be of this world.

words.ex: The door handle was unobtrusive and blended with the wall.
words.ex_cn: 门把手不显眼，与墙壁融为一体。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as unobtrusive, you mean that they are not easily noticed or do not draw attention to themselves.

words.ex: Strong foundations underpin the building.
words.ex_cn: 坚固的地基支撑着这栋建筑。
words.en: To support, strengthen, or provide a foundation for something.

words.ex: This food has good nutritional value.
words.ex_cn: 这种食物有很好的营养价值。
words.en: Relating to the process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

words.ex: The car's velocity increased on the highway.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在高速公路上的速度增加了。
words.en: Velocity is the speed at which something moves in a particular direction.

words.tr: v. 摘下面纱；揭幕；揭露
words.ex: They will unveil the statue tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他们明天将摘下雕像的面纱。
words.en: If someone unveils something such as a new statue or painting, they show it to the public for the first time.

words.ex: The engineer built a prototype of the new car.
words.ex_cn: 工程师制作了这辆新车的原型。
words.en: A prototype is the first or original example of something that has been or will be copied or developed; it is a model or preliminary version.

words.tr:
v. （使）旋转
n. 转环；旋轴
words.ex: The chair can swivel easily.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子可以轻松旋转。
words.en: A swivel is a device that allows something to turn around freely, or to turn something around freely.

words.ex: The scientist tried to replicate the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 这位科学家试图复制这个实验。
words.en: To replicate something means to do or make something again in exactly the same way.

words.ex: The small boat capsize in the storm.
words.ex_cn: 小船在风暴中倾覆了。
words.en: If a boat capsizes or if you capsize it, it turns over in the water.

words.tr:
n. 计划；方案；项目；课题；
v. 投射；预计；
words.ex: He presented his school project to the class.
words.ex_cn: 他向全班展示了他的学校计划。
words.en: A project is a piece of work that is planned or intended, or a large piece of work that is done by a group of people.

words.ex: He plays the drum in a band.
words.ex_cn: 他在乐队里打鼓。
words.en: A drum is a musical instrument consisting of a skin stretched tightly over a round frame. You play it by hitting it with sticks or with your hands.

words.ex: The political issue is thorny and hard to solve.
words.ex_cn: 这个政治问题很棘手，难以解决。
words.en: A thorny problem or subject is difficult to deal with because it is complex and involves many different aspects.

words.tr: adj. 有资格的；合格的；合意的；
words.ex: He is eligible to vote because he is 18 years old.
words.ex_cn: 他年满18岁，有资格投票。
words.en: Someone who is eligible for something is qualified or allowed to do it.

words.ex: He finally admit his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you admit that something bad, unpleasant, or embarrassing is true, you agree, often unwillingly, that it is true.

words.ex: The bacterial infection made him very sick.
words.ex_cn: 细菌感染让他病得很重。
words.en: Relating to or caused by bacteria.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.ex: His enrolment at the university starts next month.
words.ex_cn: 他在大学的入学时间是下个月。
words.en: Enrolment refers to the process of signing up or registering for something, such as a school, course, or program.

words.ex: The team made a smart strategy to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 这个团队制定了一项聪明的策略来赢得比赛。
words.en: A strategy is a plan that you use in order to achieve something.

words.ex: A bird emerged from the trees.
words.ex_cn: 一只鸟从树中浮现出来。
words.en: If something or someone emerges, they come out of or move out of something and become visible.

words.ex: The diver submerge to explore the coral reef.
words.ex_cn: 潜水员潜水去探索珊瑚礁。
words.en: To submerge something means to put it below the surface of a liquid, especially water. If something submerges, it goes below the surface of a liquid.

words.ex: The mantle lies below the Earth's crust.
words.ex_cn: 地幔位于地球地壳之下。
words.en: The mantle is the part of the earth between the crust and the core. It can also refer to a cloak or covering.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全面的；总体的；
adv. 总计；大致上；
words.ex: The overall cost is too high.
words.ex_cn: 总成本太高了。
words.en: You use overall to indicate that you are talking about a situation in general or about the whole of something.

words.ex: The table is made of granite.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是花岗岩做的。
words.en: Granite is a very hard rock that is often used in building.

words.tr:
adj. 近似的；大约的；
v. 接近；
words.ex: The approximate cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 费用大约是50美元。
words.en: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

words.ex: We visited an art gallery on Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 我们周日参观了一家艺术画廊。
words.en: A gallery is a place where works of art are shown to the public.

words.ex: The community cleaned the park together.
words.ex_cn: 社区居民一起清理了公园。
words.en: A community is a group of people who live in the same area or who have the same interests, religion, or nationality.

words.tr:
n. 摇摆；
v. 摇摆；
words.ex: The child enjoyed the swing at the park.
words.ex_cn: 孩子喜欢在公园里荡秋千。
words.en: If something swings or if you swing it, it moves repeatedly backwards and forwards or from side to side from a fixed point. If you swing somewhere, you move there by holding onto something and moving your body through the air.

words.ex: He cited a book in his essay.
words.ex_cn: 他在文章中引用了一本书。
words.en: To cite something means to quote it or mention it as evidence or proof of what you are saying.

words.ex: The colors in the rainbow cover a wide spectrum.
words.ex_cn: 彩虹中的颜色覆盖了广泛的范围。
words.en: A spectrum is a range of a particular type of thing, often a range of colors, ideas, or opinions.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: He showed his identity card to enter the building.
words.ex_cn: 他出示了身份证以进入大楼。
words.en: Your identity is who you are, or the qualities of a person or group that make them different from others.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.tr:
adj. 极度的；
n. 极端；极端的事物；
words.ex: He felt extreme pain after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他在事故后感到极度疼痛。
words.en: If you describe something as extreme, you mean that it is very great in degree or intensity.

words.ex: He skipped the hard question and moved to the next one.
words.ex_cn: 他略过了难题，继续做下一题。
words.en: To move lightly and quickly, making a small jump after each step.

words.tr:
adj. 军事的；军用的；
n. 军队；武装力量；
words.ex: The military base is near the border.
words.ex_cn: 军事基地靠近边境。
words.en: relating to or characteristic of soldiers or armed forces

words.tr:
n. 毒药；毒物；
v. 毒害；
words.ex: The snake's poison can kill quickly.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒药能迅速致死。
words.en: A poison is a substance that causes harm or death if it is swallowed, absorbed, or breathed in. It can also refer to something that has a very harmful effect on something else.

words.ex: He invested money in a small business.
words.ex_cn: 他投资了一笔钱在一家小企业上。
words.en: If you invest in something, or if you invest a sum of money, you use your money in a way that you hope will increase its value, for example by paying it into a bank, or buying shares or property.

words.ex: He listened to a beautiful symphony last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚听了一首美妙的交响乐。
words.en: A symphony is a long piece of music that is usually in four parts and is performed by an orchestra.

words.tr: v. 确定…的位置；使坐落于；查找…的地点；
words.ex: Can you locate the hotel on the map?
words.ex_cn: 你能在地图上找到酒店的位置吗？
words.en: To locate something means to find out exactly where it is, or to establish something in a particular place.

words.ex: The teacher will classify the students by age.
words.ex_cn: 老师将按年龄对学生进行分类。
words.en: To classify things means to divide them into groups or types so that things with similar characteristics are in the same group.

words.tr: adj. 充满热情的；热心的；
words.ex: He is enthusiastic about playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他对打篮球充满热情。
words.en: If you are enthusiastic about something, you show how much you like or enjoy it by the way that you behave and talk.

words.ex: He will alter the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会改动计划。
words.en: To alter something means to change it, usually slightly, or to cause the characteristics of something to change.

words.tr: v. 使不合格；剥夺资格
words.ex: He was disqualified for breaking the rules.
words.ex_cn: 他因为违反规则而被取消资格。
words.en: If someone is disqualified from something, they are officially stopped from doing it, usually because they have done something wrong or broken a rule.

words.ex: The school stores student records in a database.
words.ex_cn: 学校将学生记录存储在数据库中。
words.en: A database is a collection of data that is organized so that it can easily be accessed, managed, and updated.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.ex: The delivery of the package took three days.
words.ex_cn: 这个包裹的交付花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of delivering letters, parcels, or goods.

words.ex: He is an undergraduate at Harvard.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的一名本科生。
words.en: An undergraduate is a student at a university or college who is studying for their first degree.

words.tr:
v. 集中；聚焦；
n. 中心点；焦点；
words.ex: He needs to focus on his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他需要集中精力做作业。
words.en: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

words.tr: v. 给予（药物或治疗）；管理；实施；
words.ex: The nurse will administer the medicine to the patient.
words.ex_cn: 护士会给病人服药。
words.en: To administer means to manage or oversee the execution, use, or conduct of something; to dispense or apply (a remedy or drug).

words.ex: The fire left ash on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 火在地面上留下了灰烬。
words.en: the powdery residue left after the burning of a substance

words.ex: The storm will intensify tonight.
words.ex_cn: 风暴今晚会加强。
words.en: To make or become more intense or intensive.

words.ex: The store made an inventory of all the products.
words.ex_cn: 商店对所有商品做了一份清单。
words.en: An inventory is a detailed list of all the items in a place.

words.tr: n. 事件；大事；比赛项目；
words.ex: The school event was fun for everyone.
words.ex_cn: 学校的活动对每个人都很有趣。
words.en: An event is something that happens, especially when it is unusual or important.

words.tr: adj. 至关重要的；决定性的；
words.ex: It is crucial to drink water every day.
words.ex_cn: 每天喝水至关重要。
words.en: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

words.tr:
n. 阶段；时期；舞台；
v. 举行；上演；
words.ex: This is a critical stage in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这是他康复过程中的一个关键阶段。
words.en: A stage is a raised area in a theatre or hall where performers, speakers, or entertainers stand. It can also refer to a particular point or period in the development or progress of something.

words.ex: The farmer uses aeration to help plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用通气来帮助植物生长。
words.en: The process of exposing to air, or of causing air to circulate through a substance.

words.ex: This small business is profitable.
words.ex_cn: 这家小企业有利可图的。
words.en: If something is profitable, it makes a profit or is beneficial.

words.ex: The virus made many people sick.
words.ex_cn: 这个病毒让很多人病了。
words.en: A virus is a very small organism that causes infectious diseases in people, animals, and plants.

words.ex: He has faith in his ability to win.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己赢得比赛有信心。
words.en: Strong belief in the doctrines of a religion, based on spiritual conviction rather than proof.

words.tr: n. 自助餐厅；自助食堂；
words.ex: We ate lunch in the school cafeteria.
words.ex_cn: 我们在学校自助餐厅吃午饭。
words.en: A cafeteria is a type of food service location within an institution in which there is little or no waiting staff table service, whether a restaurant or within an institution such as a large office building or school; a school dining location is also referred to as a dining hall or canteen (in British English).

words.ex: The project involves simple math and writing.
words.ex_cn: 这个项目包括简单的数学和写作。
words.en: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

words.tr:
adj. 牛奶的；乳品的；
n. 乳品店；
words.ex: She bought dairy products from the local farm.
words.ex_cn: 她从当地农场买了乳制品。
words.en: A dairy is a place where milk and cream are kept or where butter and cheese are made.

words.ex: The test results confirm he has the disease.
words.ex_cn: 检测结果证实他患有这种疾病。
words.en: To confirm something means to establish its truth or validity by providing evidence or proof.

words.ex: The door opens on a metal hinge.
words.ex_cn: 这扇门装在一个金属枢纽上。
words.en: A hinge is a piece of metal, wood, or plastic that is used to join two things together so that one of them can swing or move freely.

words.ex: The hurricane destroyed many houses.
words.ex_cn: 飓风摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: A hurricane is an extremely violent wind or storm.

words.ex: The government subsidize small businesses to help them grow.
words.ex_cn: 政府资助小企业以帮助它们发展。
words.en: To subsidize something means to pay part of the cost of it, usually as a way of helping people or organizations that cannot afford to pay the full cost themselves.

words.tr:
n. 污点；
v. 玷污；
words.ex: There is a coffee stain on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一个咖啡污点。
words.en: A stain is a mark on something that is difficult to remove, especially one made by a liquid such as blood or coffee. To stain something means to leave a mark on it that is difficult to remove.

words.ex: The workers unload the boxes from the truck.
words.ex_cn: 工人们从卡车上卸下箱子。
words.en: To remove goods from a vehicle, ship, container, etc.

words.ex: The conversion of water into steam takes heat.
words.ex_cn: 水变成蒸汽需要热量。
words.en: The process of changing or causing something to change from one form to another.

words.tr: adj. 无关紧要的；不相关的；
words.ex: His opinion is irrelevant to the decision.
words.ex_cn: 他的意见与这个决定无关紧要。
words.en: If you describe something as irrelevant, you mean that it is not important to or not connected with the present situation or discussion.

words.ex: The roller coaster gave her a thrill.
words.ex_cn: 过山车让她感到兴奋。
words.en: A thrill is a sudden feeling of great excitement, pleasure, or fear.

words.ex: The doctor ran a trial to test the new medicine.
words.ex_cn: 医生进行了试验来测试这种新药。
words.en: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

words.ex: He extols the beauty of nature every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天赞美大自然的美。
words.en: If you extol something or someone, you praise them enthusiastically.

words.ex: He passed the test, albeit with a low score.
words.ex_cn: 他通过了考试，尽管分数很低。
